Co连续的ntinuousLa帐篷扩散语言模型tent Diffusion Language Model

Hongcan Guo    Qinyu Zhao    Yian Zhao    Shen Nie    Rui Zhu    Qiushan Guo    Feng Wang    Tao Yang    Hengshuang Zhao    Guoqiang Wei    Yan Zeng [ [ [ [ [ zengyan.yanne@bytedance.com
(2026 年 5 月 7 日May 7, 2026)
摘要Abstract

大型语言模型在自回归范式下取得了显着的成功，但高质量的文本生成不需要依赖于固定的从左到右的顺序。现有的替代方案仍然难以共同实现生成效率、可扩展的表示学习和有效的全局语义建模。我们建议Large language models have achieved remarkable success under the autoregressive paradigm, yet high-quality text generation need not be tied to a fixed left-to-right order. Existing alternatives still struggle to jointly achieve generation efficiency, scalable representation learning, and effective global semantic modeling. We propose𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM，一种分层潜在扩散语言模型，通过分层信息分解构建文本生成。, a hierarchical latent diffusion language model that frames text generation through hierarchical information decomposition.𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM首先使用文本 VAE 学习稳定的文本到潜在映射，然后使用块因果 DiT 在连续潜在空间中对全局语义先验进行建模，最后通过条件解码生成文本。从统一的马尔可夫路径的角度来看，其扩散过程执行潜在的先验传输而不是令牌级的观察恢复，从而将全局语义组织与局部文本实现分开。这种设计产生了更灵活的非自回归归纳偏差，支持连续空间中的语义压缩和先验拟合，并自然地扩展到其他连续模态。通过跨越 4 个研究问题、8 个基准的实验，严格匹配first learns a stable text-to-latent mapping with a Text VAE, then models a global semantic prior in continuous latent space with a block-causal DiT, and finally generates text through conditional decoding. From a unified Markov-path perspective, its diffusion process performs latent prior transport rather than token-level observation recovery, thereby separating global semantic organization from local textual realization. This design yields a more flexible non-autoregressive inductive bias, supports semantic compression and prior fitting in continuous space, and naturally extends to other continuous modalities. Through experiments spanning 4 research questions, 8 benchmarks, strictly matched∼\sim2B 参数自回归和 LLaDA 基线，以及高达约 2000 EFLOP 的缩放曲线，我们确定了一种有效的整体配置2B-parameter autoregressive and LLaDA baselines, and scaling curves up to about 2000 EFLOPs, we identify an effective overall configuration of𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM并验证其强大的文本生成缩放行为。总而言之，结果将分层连续潜在先验建模作为严格标记级语言建模的原则性替代方案，其中生成质量和缩放行为可能比可能性更好地反映模型能力，同时还提出了跨离散文本和连续模态统一建模的具体路径。and verify its strong scaling behavior for text generation. Taken together, the results establish hierarchical continuous latent prior modeling as a principled alternative to strictly token-level language modeling, where generation quality and scaling behavior may better reflect model capability than likelihood, while also suggesting a concrete path toward unified modeling across discrete text and continuous modalities.

1 简介Introduction

大型语言模型在自回归范式下取得了显着的成功Large language models have achieved remarkable success under the autoregressive paradigm[9, 30, 55, 38, 91]。通过链式法则分解离散文本分布. By factorizing the discrete text distribution through the chain rule[60, 6, 45, 39, 22, 102]，自回归语言模型推动了大规模预训练、开放式生成和下游迁移方面的重大进步，并已成为现代语言建模的主导方法, autoregressive language models have driven major advances in large-scale pretraining, open-ended generation, and downstream transfer, and have become the dominant approach to modern language modeling[73, 65, 13, 96, 111]。然而，这种范式将生成与固定的从左到右的顺序紧密耦合，使得推理本质上是顺序的，并将模型的归纳偏差限制为单个标记排序. However, this paradigm tightly couples generation to a fixed left-to-right order, making inference inherently sequential and restricting the model’s inductive bias to a single token ordering[3, 98, 50, 67, 1, 23, 104]。基于离散和连续扩散的文本建模的最新进展表明，高质量的语言生成不需要依赖于这种固定的顺序；相反，语言模型也可以通过更一般的状态演化和去噪路径来定义. Recent progress in both discrete and continuous diffusion-based text modeling suggests that high-quality language generation need not rely on such a fixed order; instead, language models can also be defined through more general state evolution and denoising paths[103, 106, 72, 87, 15, 59].

尽管沿着自回归、离散扩散和连续扩散方向进行了广泛的探索Despite extensive exploration along autoregressive, discrete diffusion, and continuous diffusion directions[85, 95, 49, 99, 26, 41, 42, 47]，现有方法仍然难以同时实现生成效率、可扩展表示和全局语义建模。自回归模型直接参数化标记级条件概率，产生明确的训练目标，但其固定的生成顺序会产生固有的顺序推理成本，并引入强烈的手工归纳偏差，这限制了更一般的生成任务的性能, existing methods still struggle to simultaneously achieve generation efficiency, scalable representation, and global semantic modeling. Autoregressive models directly parameterize token-level conditional probabilities, yielding a clear training objective, but their fixed generation order incurs inherent sequential inference cost and introduces a strong hand-crafted inductive bias, which limits performance on more general generation tasks[53, 7, 20, 17, 119]。离散扩散语言模型消除了显式的从左到右分解. Discrete diffusion language models remove explicit left-to-right factorization[35, 25, 36, 110]，但它们通常仍然在离散标记空间中执行观察恢复，导致昂贵的多步采样，而中间离散状态不太适合稳定地表示全局语义结构, yet they still typically perform observation recovery in discrete token space, leading to costly multi-step sampling, while intermediate discrete states are not well suited to stably represent global semantic structure[115, 116, 94, 86, 90, 62, 40]。连续扩散方法进一步引入连续表示空间. Continuous diffusion methods further introduce continuous representation spaces[81, 28, 89]，但大多数现有方法仍然使用扩散路径来恢复标记对齐的表示，而不是显式地建模潜在的先验, but most existing approaches still use the diffusion path to recover token-aligned representations rather than to explicitly model a latent prior[29, 21]。因此，当前的方法尚未提供一个统一的框架来系统地结合非自回归生成、连续表示和概率文本建模。. As a result, current methods have not yet provided a unified framework that systematically combines non-autoregressive generation, continuous representation, and probabilistic text modeling.

为了弥补这一差距，我们建议To address this gap, we propose𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM，分层潜在空间扩散语言模型。, a hierarchical latent-space diffusion language model.𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM首先通过文本 VAE 学习文本和连续潜在变量之间的稳定映射first learns a stable mapping between text and continuous latent variables through a Text VAE[112, 100, 83, 51, 8, 46]，然后使用块因果 DiT 对连续潜在空间中的潜在先验进行建模, then models the latent prior in continuous latent space with a block-causal DiT[76, 12, 75, 66, 57, 11, 4, 108]，最后通过条件解码器生成文本。关键思想是, and finally generates text through a conditional decoder. The key idea of𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM是使用扩散不是为了令牌级别的观察恢复，而是为了潜在的先验传输。从统一的马尔可夫路径的角度来看，该设计明确地将文本生成分解为两个层次：连续潜在空间中的全局语义组织和通过条件解码的局部文本实现。这种分解削弱了固定标记顺序带来的归纳偏差，允许连续空间的几何结构直接支持语义压缩和先验拟合，并实现更灵活的非自回归生成过程。此外，块因果先验建模保留了跨块因果结构，同时允许每个块内更有效的并行计算。以分层潜在空间建模为基础，is to use diffusion not for token-level observation recovery, but for latent prior transport. From a unified Markov-path perspective, this design explicitly decomposes text generation into two levels: global semantic organization in continuous latent space and local textual realization through conditional decoding. This decomposition weakens the inductive bias imposed by fixed token order, allows the geometry of continuous space to directly support semantic compression and prior fitting, and enables a more flexible non-autoregressive generation process. Moreover, block-causal prior modeling preserves cross-block causal structure while allowing more efficient parallel computation within each block. Grounded in hierarchical latent-space modeling,𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM也是高度模块化的，并且可以自然地扩展到替代潜在建模组件和其他连续模式is also highly modular and naturally extensible to alternative latent modeling components and other continuous modalities[112, 19].

受这些观察的启发，我们从理论和实证的角度系统地研究了连续潜在空间中的扩散语言建模。我们的贡献如下。Motivated by these observations, we systematically study diffusion language modeling in continuous latent space from both theoretical and empirical perspectives. Our contributions are as follows.

  • •

    我们建议We propose𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM，一种分层潜在空间语言模型，在统一的概率框架内将文本生成显式分解为全局语义建模和局部文本实现，同时在连续潜在空间中使用基于扩散的先验建模将两者连接起来，从而从分层信息分解的角度建立了语言生成的新范式。, a hierarchical latent-space language model that explicitly decomposes text generation into global semantic modeling and local textual realization within a unified probabilistic framework, while using diffusion-based prior modeling in continuous latent space to connect the two, thereby establishing a new paradigm for language generation from the perspective of hierarchical information decomposition.

  • •

    我们分析一下之间的差异We analyze the differences between𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM从统一的马尔可夫路径角度与现有的语言建模范式进行比较，阐明其在全局语义建模、非自回归归纳偏差和理论可解释性方面的优势，并在后续实验中得到进一步验证。and existing language modeling paradigms from a unified Markov-path perspective, clarifying its advantages in global semantic modeling, non-autoregressive inductive bias, and theoretical interpretability, which are further validated in the subsequent experiments.

  • •

    通过涵盖 4 个研究问题、8 个基准的广泛实验，严格匹配Through extensive experiments spanning 4 research questions, 8 benchmarks, strictly matched∼\sim2B 参数自回归和 LLaDA 基线，以及高达约 2000 EFLOP 的缩放曲线，我们系统地验证了以下核心主张：2B-parameter autoregressive and LLaDA baselines, and scaling curves up to about 2000 EFLOPs, we systematically validate the central claims of𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM，确定有效的整体配置，并验证其对于文本生成的强大潜力和有利的扩展行为。, identify an effective overall configuration, and verify its strong potential and favorable scaling behavior for text generation.

  • •

    我们进一步分析了核心框架之外的几个问题，包括似然估计和生成质量、第一块调节和潜在压缩之间的不匹配。我们还提供了初步证据表明We further analyze several issues beyond the core framework, including the mismatch between likelihood estimation and generation quality, first-block conditioning, and latent compression. We also provide preliminary evidence that𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM提供了从离散文本到视觉等连续模式的自然桥梁，指向更广泛的统一生成范式。offers a natural bridge from discrete text to continuous modalities such as vision, pointing to a broader unified generative paradigm.

2 相关工作Related Work

2.1 自回归语言模型Autoregressive Language Models

自回归语言模型Autoregressive language models[77, 92, 101, 56]通过链式法则分解离散文本分布，并使用标记级最大似然进行训练，使其成为最广泛采用的文本建模范例。它们的局限性在于，生成受到固定的从左到右顺序的约束，推理本质上是顺序的，并且不太适合填充、本地编辑和全局重组等非单调生成任务。相比之下，factorize the discrete text distribution by the chain rule and are trained with token-level maximum likelihood, making them the most widely adopted paradigm for text modeling. Their limitations are that generation is constrained by a fixed left-to-right order, inference is inherently sequential, and they are less suitable for non-monotonic generation tasks such as infilling, local editing, and global reorganization. In contrast,𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM首先在连续潜在空间中对全局语义先验进行建模，然后执行条件解码，从而减轻 token 级排序偏差并通过块因果 DiT 提高生成效率。first models a global semantic prior in a continuous latent space and then performs conditional decoding, thereby alleviating token-level ordering bias and improving generation efficiency with a block-causal DiT.

2.2 离散扩散语言模型Discrete Diffusion Language Models

离散扩散语言模型主要分为两类。第一类基于离散转移核Discrete diffusion language models mainly fall into two categories. The first category is based on discrete transition kernels[2, 10, 88]，定义离散标记空间中的前向扰动和反向恢复，并通过多步去噪实现非自回归生成；然而，采样通常很慢，并且这些方法无法轻松利用连续空间的平滑语义结构。第二类基于掩蔽或吸收状态, which define forward perturbation and reverse recovery in discrete token space and achieve non-autoregressive generation through multi-step denoising; however, sampling is usually slow and these methods cannot easily exploit the smooth semantic structure of continuous spaces. The second category is based on masking or absorbing states[80, 70, 117, 105, 118, 84, 113, 114, 81, 69]，通过逐步将标记映射到掩码或吸收状态，然后恢复原始文本来构建训练目标；然而，中间状态的信息丢失限制了全局语义规划和细粒度控制。相比之下，, which construct training objectives by progressively mapping tokens to masks or absorbing states and then recovering the original text; however, information loss in intermediate states limits global semantic planning and fine-grained control. In contrast,𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM将扩散过程移动到连续的潜在空间，其中可压缩的潜在变量携带全局语义，从而将连续空间的可操作性与分层语义建模结合起来。moves the diffusion process to a continuous latent space, where compressible latent variables carry global semantics, thus combining the manipulability of continuous spaces with hierarchical semantic modeling.

2.3 连续扩散语言模型Continuous Diffusion Language Models

连续扩散语言模型可以大致分为三类。第一类由高维词汇对齐连续方法组成Continuous diffusion language models can be broadly divided into three categories. The first category consists of high-dimensional vocabulary-aligned continuous methods[31, 79, 59, 43]，直接对 one-hot 向量、logit 单纯形或概率单纯形执行连续扩散或流建模，以保持与离散词汇表的对齐；然而，它们的表示维度随着词汇量的大小而变化，这限制了可扩展性。第二类包括基于标记嵌入的连续方法, which perform continuous diffusion or flow modeling directly on one-hot vectors, logit simplexes, or probability simplexes to preserve alignment with discrete vocabularies; however, their representation dimension scales with vocabulary size, which limits scalability. The second category consists of token-embedding-based continuous methods[52, 87, 24, 27, 29, 14, 54, 21]，首先将文本映射到连续的嵌入空间，然后应用扩散或流建模来提高生成灵活性；然而，它们的生成过程本质上仍然是噪声目标表示的恢复，缺乏明确的分层潜变量解释和文本分布的统一边际似然视图。第三类包括潜在空间连续方法, which first map text into continuous embedding spaces and then apply diffusion or flow modeling to improve generation flexibility; however, their generation process remains essentially the recovery of noisy target representations, lacking an explicit hierarchical latent-variable interpretation and a unified marginal-likelihood view of text distributions. The third category consists of latent-space continuous methods[63, 44, 58, 109]，它使用自动编码器或 VAE 将文本压缩到潜在空间，然后执行扩散建模。这些方法通常依赖于潜在空间设计和自回归解码器，并且通常将潜在空间视为固定表示，而不是在分层潜在变量框架下对其进行建模。相比之下，, which compress text into latent spaces with autoencoders or VAEs and then perform diffusion modeling. These methods typically rely on latent-space design and autoregressive decoders, and usually treat the latent space as a fixed representation rather than modeling it under a hierarchical latent-variable framework. In contrast,𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM通过分层潜变量建模将全局语义与局部实现显式分离，并在动态连续潜在空间中学习语义先验，从而更好地平衡建模灵活性、推理效率和理论可解释性。explicitly separates global semantics from local realization through hierarchical latent-variable modeling, and learns a semantic prior in a dynamic continuous latent space, thereby better balancing modeling flexibility, inference efficiency, and theoretical interpretability.

We also outline the overall workflow of𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM。然后我们放置. We then place𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM与 AR 模型、离散去噪语言模型和连续标记空间方法一起在统一的理论框架中。详细推导和证明见附录in a unified theoretical framework together with AR models, discrete denoising language models, and continuous token-space methods. Detailed derivations and proofs are deferred to Appendices9, 10, 11和and12.

3.2 可乐DLM的工作流程Workflow of Cola DLM

在本节中，我们将描述总体工作流程In this section, we describe the overall workflow of𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM详细地。如图所示in detail. As illustrated in Figure1，我们从三个角度解释该方法：Text VAE的预训练、使用Text DiT进行先验学习的预训练以及, we explain the method from three perspectives: the pretraining of the Text VAE, the pretraining of prior learning with the Text DiT, and the inference process of𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM.

3.2.1 文本 VAE 预训练Text VAE Pretraining

在第一阶段，我们学习稳定的潜在文本对应关系。编码器将文本映射到潜在空间，解码器根据潜在空间重建原始文本：In the first stage, we learn a stable latent–text correspondence. The encoder maps text into the latent space, and the decoder reconstructs the original text conditioned on the latent:

z0∼qϕ​(z0∣x),x^∼pθ​(x∣z0).z_{0}\sim q_{\phi}(z_{0}\mid x),\qquad\hat{x}\sim p_{\theta}(x\mid z_{0}). (3.15)

这一阶段的目标不是学习最终的先验，而是在潜在存储的信息和解码器恢复的信息之间建立稳定的分工。The goal of this stage is not to learn the final prior, but to establish a stable division of labor between information stored in the latent and information recovered by the decoder.

相应的目标是The corresponding objective is

ℒVAE=−𝔼qϕ​(z0∣x)​log⁡pθ​(x∣z0)+β​KL​(qϕ​(z0∣x)∥pbase​(z0))+λmask​ℒmask.\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{VAE}}=-\mathbb{E}_{q_{\phi}(z_{0}\mid x)}\log p_{\theta}(x\mid z_{0})+\beta\,\mathrm{KL}(q_{\phi}(z_{0}\mid x)\,\|\,p_{\mathrm{base}}(z_{0}))+\lambda_{\mathrm{mask}}\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{mask}}. (3.16)

在这里，Here,ℒmask\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{mask}}就是图中所示的BERT式掩蔽损失。它可以防止 VAE 编码器在语义上崩溃，而解码器仅记住表面文本。在我们的实验中，VAE 不会压缩序列长度。为了防止信息泄漏并促进后续流生成，我们的 VAE 编码器和解码器都是严格因果的。is the BERT-style masking loss shown in the figure. It prevents the VAE encoder from collapsing semantically while the decoder merely memorizes surface text. In our experiments, the VAE does not compress the sequence length. To prevent information leakage and facilitate subsequent streaming generation, both our VAE encoder and decoder are strictly causal.

3.2.2 使用 Block-Causal DiT 进行先验学习Prior Learning with Block-Causal DiT

在第二阶段，我们学习稳定潜在空间的条件先验。对于块In the second stage, we learn a conditional prior on the stabilized latent space. For blockbb，可见集由历史干净的潜在块和当前的噪声块组成：, the visible set consists of the historical clean latent blocks and the current noisy block:

𝒱b={sg⁡(z0(<b)),zt(b)},\mathcal{V}_{b}=\left\{\operatorname{sg}(z_{0}^{(<b)}),\,z_{t}^{(b)}\right\}, (3.17)

哪里wheresg⁡(⋅)\operatorname{sg}(\cdot)表示停止梯度。这种可见性约束强制每个块内的双向注意力和跨块的因果依赖性，与等式1一致。 （denotes stop-gradient. This visibility constraint enforces bidirectional attention within each block and causal dependence across blocks, consistent with Eq. (3.3).

在这种设计下，先验学习使用将条件流匹配与参考编码器正则化器相结合的联合目标：Under this design, prior learning uses a joint objective that combines conditional Flow Matching with a reference-encoder regularizer:

ℒstage2=\displaystyle\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{stage2}}= λVAE​(−𝔼qϕ​(z0∣x)​log⁡pθ​(x∣z0)+β​𝔼qϕ​(z0∣x)​log⁡qϕ​(z0∣x)+λmask​ℒmask)\displaystyle\;\lambda_{\mathrm{VAE}}\Bigl(-\mathbb{E}_{q_{\phi}(z_{0}\mid x)}\log p_{\theta}(x\mid z_{0})+\beta\mathbb{E}_{q_{\phi}(z_{0}\mid x)}\log q_{\phi}(z_{0}\mid x)+\lambda_{\mathrm{mask}}\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{mask}}\Bigr) (3.18)
+λfmℒFM+λref𝔼pdata​(x)KL(qϕ(z0∣x)∥qϕref(z0∣x)).\displaystyle\;+\lambda_{\mathrm{fm}}\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{FM}}+\lambda_{\mathrm{ref}}\mathbb{E}_{p_{\mathrm{data}}(x)}\mathrm{KL}\!\Bigl(q_{\phi}(z_{0}\mid x)\,\|\,q_{\phi_{\mathrm{ref}}}(z_{0}\mid x)\Bigr).

第一组通过正则化潜在学习保留自动编码结构，第二项学习块级条件先验，第三项在联合训练期间抑制潜在漂移。The first group preserves the autoencoding structure with regularized latent learning, the second term learns the block-level conditional prior, and the third term suppresses latent drift during joint training.

3.2.3 推理：前缀编码、分块生成和条件解码Inference: Prefix Encoding, Block-wise Generation, and Conditional Decoding

在推理时，模型首先将前缀编码为干净的潜在条件：At inference time, the model first encodes the prefix into clean latent conditions:

zpre∼qϕ​(zpre∣xpre).z^{\mathrm{pre}}\sim q_{\phi}(z^{\mathrm{pre}}\mid x^{\mathrm{pre}}). (3.19)

然后它逐块生成响应潜在值。每个块都是通过在历史条件下传输噪声种子得到的：It then generates the response latent block by block. Each block is obtained by transporting a noise seed under the historical condition:

z^0(b)=Φ0←1ψ​(ϵ(b);zpre,z^0(<b)),ϵ(b)∼𝒩​(0,I).\hat{z}_{0}^{(b)}=\Phi^{\psi}_{0\leftarrow 1}\!\Bigl(\epsilon^{(b)};\,z^{\mathrm{pre}},\hat{z}_{0}^{(<b)}\Bigr),\qquad\epsilon^{(b)}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,I). (3.20)

最后，解码器输出以前缀和生成的潜在块为条件的文本响应：Finally, the decoder outputs the text response conditioned on the prefix and the generated latent blocks:

x^res∼pθ​(xres∣zpre,z^0(1:B)).\hat{x}^{\mathrm{res}}\sim p_{\theta}\!\bigl(x^{\mathrm{res}}\mid z^{\mathrm{pre}},\hat{z}_{0}^{(1:B)}\bigr). (3.21)

3.3 Cola DLM 和现有方法的统一视图A Unified View of Cola DLM and Existing Methods

More detailed analysis and proofs are provided in Appendices11和and12.

3.3.1 统一随机路径视图下的文本建模Text Modeling under a Unified Stochastic-Path View

为了统一比较，令For a unified comparison, letτ=(St)t∈𝒯\tau=(S_{t})_{t\in\mathcal{T}}是状态空间上的随机过程be a stochastic process on state space𝒮\mathcal{S}，初始分布, with initial distributionμΘ\mu_{\Theta}, 过渡核, transition kernelKtΘK_{t}^{\Theta}和排放机制, and emission mechanismeΘ​(x∣τ)e_{\Theta}(x\mid\tau)。基于过程的生成模型可以写为. A process-based generative model can be written as

pΘ​(x)=∫eΘ​(x∣τ)​PΘ​(d​τ),PΘ​(d​τ)=μΘ​(d​s0)​∏t>0KtΘ​(d​st∣s<t).p_{\Theta}(x)=\int e_{\Theta}(x\mid\tau)\,P_{\Theta}(d\tau),\qquad P_{\Theta}(d\tau)=\mu_{\Theta}(ds_{0})\prod_{t>0}K_{t}^{\Theta}(ds_{t}\mid s_{<t}). (3.22)

这种共同的外部形式并不决定模型的性质。本质区别在于路径的状态空间及其语义角色：文本或近无损文本对齐表示上的路径是观察路径，而仅用于生成潜在先验的路径是先验路径。This common outer form does not determine the nature of the model. The essential distinction lies in the state space of the path and its semantic role: a path over text or near-lossless text-aligned representations is an observation path, whereas a path used only to generate a latent prior is a prior path.

对于 AR，路径是前缀扩展本身，产生精确的链分解，但将生成绑定到从左到右的过滤：For AR, the path is the prefix expansion itself, yielding an exact chain factorization but binding generation to a left-to-right filtration:

pAR​(x)=∏i=1Lpη​(xi∣x<i).p_{\mathrm{AR}}(x)=\prod_{i=1}^{L}p_{\eta}(x_{i}\mid x_{<i}). (3.23)

对于LLaDA，路径是离散的损坏-恢复轨迹，其目标是离散状态空间中的观测重建：For LLaDA, the path is a discrete corruption–recovery trajectory, whose objective is observation reconstruction in a discrete state space:

q​(s1:T∣x)=q1​(s1∣x)​∏t=2Tqt​(st∣st−1),pθ​(s0:T)=p​(sT)​∏t=1Tpθ​(st−1∣st).q(s_{1:T}\mid x)=q_{1}(s_{1}\mid x)\prod_{t=2}^{T}q_{t}(s_{t}\mid s_{t-1}),\qquad p_{\theta}(s_{0:T})=p(s_{T})\prod_{t=1}^{T}p_{\theta}(s_{t-1}\mid s_{t}). (3.24)

因此，LLaDA 削弱了手工设计的从左到右的偏差，但仍然修改了观察恢复过程，而不是引入显式的分层潜在变量。Thus, LLaDA weakens the handcrafted left-to-right bias, but still modifies the observation-recovery process rather than introducing an explicit hierarchical latent variable.

Plaid 进一步将这个恢复过程转移到连续的令牌对齐表示中Plaid further moves this recovery process to a continuous token-aligned representationh0=E​(x)h_{0}=E(x):

q​(h1:T∣h0)=q1​(h1∣h0)​∏t=2Tqt​(ht∣ht−1),pθ​(h0:T)=p​(hT)​∏t=1Tpθ​(ht−1∣ht).q(h_{1:T}\mid h_{0})=q_{1}(h_{1}\mid h_{0})\prod_{t=2}^{T}q_{t}(h_{t}\mid h_{t-1}),\qquad p_{\theta}(h_{0:T})=p(h_{T})\prod_{t=1}^{T}p_{\theta}(h_{t-1}\mid h_{t}). (3.25)

因此，其核心目标是连续观察恢复，而不是分解为先验解码器和条件解码器。Its core target is therefore continuous observation recovery, rather than a decomposition into a prior and a conditional decoder.

In 𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM相比之下，随机路径仅传输潜在先验：, by contrast, the stochastic path only transports the latent prior:

z1∼p1,z0=Φ0←1ψ​(z1),x∼pθ​(x∣z0),z_{1}\sim p_{1},\qquad z_{0}=\Phi^{\psi}_{0\leftarrow 1}(z_{1}),\qquad x\sim p_{\theta}(x\mid z_{0}), (3.26)

边际仍由方程给出。 （with the marginal still given by Eq. (3.1）。因此，扩散用于学习灵活的连续先验，而不是对文本强加从左到右的归纳偏差。). Hence, diffusion is used to learn a flexible continuous prior, not to impose a left-to-right inductive bias on text.

使用连续路径的原因并不是连续建模本身就优越，而是它自然地捕获了潜在分布的几何形状。在The reason for using a continuous path is not that continuous modeling is inherently superior, but that it naturally captures the geometry of the latent distribution. In𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM，连续性出现在, continuity appears inpψ​(z0)p_{\psi}(z_{0})，而不是在观察恢复轨迹中：, rather than in an observation-recovery trajectory:

d​ztd​t=vψ​(zt,t),pψ=(Φ0←1ψ)♯​p1.\frac{dz_{t}}{dt}=v_{\psi}(z_{t},t),\qquad p_{\psi}=(\Phi^{\psi}_{0\leftarrow 1})_{\sharp}p_{1}. (3.27)

最后，使用潜在变量的原因是显式地将语义结构与标记实现分开。预期ELBO的信息分解，Finally, the reason for using a latent variable is to explicitly separate semantic structure from token realization. The information decomposition of the expected ELBO,

4.2 Cola DLM 中全局语义结构的证据 (RQ1)Evidence of Global Semantic Structures in Cola DLM (RQ1)

在本节中，我们首先提出全局语义结构存在的含义，然后通过定量检查不同时间步长变化下不同维度的潜在空间的表现，为其存在提供强有力的经验证据。完整的理论推导、证明和技术细节在附录中提供In this section, we first present an implication for the existence of global semantic structures, and then provide strong empirical evidence for their existence by quantitatively examining the performance of latent spaces with different dimensions under different timestep shifts. The full theoretical derivation, proof, and technical details are provided in Appendix13.

基于暗示Based on Implication4.2，本节的重点不仅在于不同潜在维度下的具体最佳 loc 值，还在于随着潜在维度的变化，最佳时移的峰值位置是否表现出稳定且规则的移动。图, the focus of this section is not merely on the specific optimal loc values under different latent dimensions, but on whether the peak position of the optimal timeshift exhibits a stable and regular shift as the latent dimension varies. Figure2给出了相应的实验结果。presents the corresponding experimental results.

观察。 ❶ 最佳时移表现出与潜在维度的系统漂移。Obs. ❶ The optimal timeshift exhibits a systematic drift with the latent dimension.如图左图所示As shown in the left panel of Figure2，任务平均的最佳位置从大约, the best loc for Task Avg shifts from approximately1.01.0 at d=16d=16, 到大约, to approximately1.71.7 at d=64d=64，并进一步近似, and further to approximately2.32.3 at d=128d=128。这种趋势是明显的并且近似单调。这种现象直接与可分离零假设相矛盾。更合理的解释是，改变潜在维度会改变某些跨维度共享结构的有效噪声校准位置。. This trend is clear and approximately monotonic. This phenomenon directly contradicts the separable null hypothesis. A more plausible explanation is that changing the latent dimension alters the effective noise calibration position of some cross-dimensional shared structure.

观察。 ❷ 这一趋势在多个语义指标中是一致的。Obs. ❷ This trend is consistent across multiple semantic metrics.图右面板The right panel of Figure2进一步表明，尽管 LAMBADA、MMLU、SIQA 和 Task Avg 的最佳 loc 值并不完全相同，但随着潜在维度的增加，它们总体上都倾向于更大的 loc 区域。这表明峰值漂移不是任何单个任务的偶然波动，而是由多个语义评估共同支持的稳定现象。因此，时移调制的是不同语义任务之间共享的表示结构。further shows that, although the best loc values for LAMBADA, MMLU, SIQA, and Task Avg are not exactly the same, they all overall favor larger loc regions as the latent dimension increases. This indicates that the peak drift is not an accidental fluctuation of any single task, but rather a stable phenomenon jointly supported by multiple semantic evaluations. Therefore, what is modulated by timeshift is a representation structure shared across different semantic tasks.

观察。 ❸ 经验峰值与理论预测基本一致。Obs. ❸ The empirical peaks are broadly consistent with the theoretical predictions.在图的左侧面板中In the left panel of Figure2，虚线表示理论上预测的最佳位置值。可以看出，在所有三种潜在维度设置下，经验峰值都接近预测位置，并且漂移方向完全一致。这表明观察到的漂移不是任意的经验超参数效应，而是与附录中的理论分析一致, the dashed lines indicate the theoretically predicted optimal loc values. It can be seen that, under all three latent-dimension settings, the empirical peaks are close to the predicted positions, and the drift directions are fully consistent. This suggests that the observed drift is not an arbitrary empirical hyperparameter effect, but is instead consistent with the theoretical analysis in Appendix13，即共享的潜在结构导致维度相关的时移校准。, namely that shared latent structures lead to dimension-dependent timeshift calibration.

4.3 Cola DLM 中不同潜在空间的分析（RQ2）Analysis of Different Latent Spaces in Cola DLM (RQ2)

在本节中，我们通过定量评估和可视化对不同潜在空间进行了详细的实证研究。我们从三个角度分析潜在空间的设计：它应该是动态的还是静态的，什么潜在维度是最合适的，以及语义平滑度如何影响潜在空间的质量。基于这些分析，我们确定了优化潜在空间的最有效方向。In this section, we present a detailed empirical study of different latent spaces through both quantitative evaluation and visualization. We analyze the design of the latent space from three perspectives: whether it should be dynamic or static, what latent dimensionality is most appropriate, and how semantic smoothness contributes to latent-space quality. Based on these analyses, we identify the most effective directions for optimizing the latent space.

固定与演变的潜在空间。Fixed vs. Evolving Latent Space.

如图As shown in Figure3，本节研究训练过程中潜在空间是否应该与 DiT 共同进化。在相同的计算预算下，我们比较了五种策略：修复预训练的 VAE（Fix VAE）；从预训练权重初始化 VAE，并使用等于 DiT 学习率或缩放至的 VAE 学习率与 DiT 联合训练它, this section studies whether the latent space should evolve jointly with DiT during training. Under the same compute budget, we compare five strategies: fixing a pretrained VAE (Fix VAE); initializing the VAE from pretrained weights and jointly training it with DiT using a VAE learning rate equal to that of DiT or scaled to0.01×0.01\times（关节 DiT x1 / 关节 DiT x0.01）；以相同的学习率（All Scratch x1）联合训练随机初始化的 VAE 和 DiT；以及基于间隔的策略（Interval），其中每个(Joint DiT x1 / Joint DiT x0.01); jointly training both VAE and DiT from random initialization with the same learning rate (All Scratch x1); and an interval-based strategy (Interval), where each55k步循环包括k-step cycle consists of22联合训练的 k 个步骤，然后k steps of joint training followed by33k 步骤，VAE 冻结。总体结果表明，潜在空间既不应该保持完全固定，也不应该在没有约束的情况下从头开始联合优化。相反，最有效的策略是让它在稳定的初始化之上与 DiT 一起进化。k steps with the VAE frozen. The overall results suggest that the latent space should neither remain fully fixed nor be jointly optimized from scratch without constraint. Instead, the most effective strategy is to let it evolve together with DiT on top of a stable initialization.

4.4 可乐 DLM 中扩散过程的消融 (RQ3)Ablation on the Diffusion Process in Cola DLM (RQ3)

在本节中，我们通过消融系统地研究 DiT 模块的训练和推理设计选择。通过将定量结果与可视化相结合，我们进一步分析了观察到的优化趋势背后的机制。在训练方面，我们研究了具有不同块大小的 DiT 模型，并检查了不同噪声训练计划对下游性能的影响。在推理方面，我们研究了去噪步骤数量和无分类器指导（CFG）尺度选择的影响。In this section, we systematically study the training and inference design choices of the DiT module through ablations. By combining quantitative results with visualizations, we further analyze the mechanisms behind the observed optimization trends. On the training side, we investigate DiT models with different block sizes and examine the effect of different noise training schedules on downstream performance. On the inference side, we study the impact of the number of denoising steps and the choice of Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) scales.

4.4.1 训练阶段Training Stage

From the information-theoretic analysis in Appendix15，改变调度位置不仅仅是改变训练时间启发式：它有效地改变了去噪过程的 logSNR 轨迹，因此改变了在不同时间步长下潜在的可用语义信息量。附录中提供了时间步长平移公式和可视化, changing the schedule location is not merely changing a training-time heuristic: it effectively shifts the logSNR trajectory of the denoising process, and therefore changes how much semantic information remains available in the latent at different timesteps. The timestep shift formula and visualizations are provided in Appendix16.9和and16.8.

5 讨论Discussion

在本节中，我们进一步研究几个附加属性和扩展In this section, we further examine several additional properties and extensions of𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM。我们关注似然导向估计和生成质量之间的结构差距，分析不同的条件和填充策略如何影响块因果. We focus on the structural gap between likelihood-oriented estimation and generation quality, analyze how different conditioning and padding strategies affect block-causal𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM在第一生成块中，提出了基于 VAE 的文本压缩以实现更快生成的初步探索。最后，我们强调更广泛的潜力in the first generation block, and present a preliminary exploration of VAE-based text compression for faster generation. Finally, we highlight the broader potential of𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM用于与其他连续模式相结合。for combining with other continuous modalities.

5.1 面向似然的估计和生成质量之间的结构性差距The Structural Gap Between Likelihood-Oriented Estimation and Generation Quality

本节研究连续潜在语言模型中的一个中心现象：生成质量已经是合理的，而面向可能性的 PPL 仍然很差。关键原因是这两个指标针对不同的属性。生成仅需要先验质量到达语义解码器有效区域，而面向似然的估计还需要围绕地面实况目标的后邻域进行精确的局部概率校准。This section studies a central phenomenon in continuous latent language models: generation quality can already be reasonable while likelihood-oriented PPL remains poor. The key reason is that these two metrics target different properties. Generation only requires the prior mass to reach semantically decoder-valid regions, whereas likelihood-oriented estimation additionally requires accurate local probability calibration around the posterior neighborhood of the ground-truth target.

In Figure11，解码器探测成功率和后验命中率始终很高，表明解码器可以可靠地恢复后验邻域内的地面实况标记。然而，先前的命中率变化很大，这表明主要问题不是解码器故障，而是黄金潜在区域周围的先前未对准。表, decoder probe success and posterior hit are consistently high, showing that the decoder can reliably recover the ground-truth token inside the posterior neighborhood. However, the prior hit rates vary sharply, indicating that the main issue is not decoder failure but prior misalignment around the gold latent region. Table4在令牌级别显示相同的模式：shows the same pattern at the token level: forat，似然导出的 PPL 显着提高, the likelihood-derived PPL improves dramatically from1.15×1061.15\times 10^{6} to 641.57641.57然后and then245.36245.36，而生成的令牌会恶化, while the generated token deteriorates fromon to in然后是逗号。同样，对于and then to a comma. Thus, lower likelihood-derived PPL does not necessarily imply better generation.

表中固定的 VAE logSNR 设置The fixed VAE logSNR settings in Table4因此，应该被解释为改变潜在概率空间的平滑度，而不仅仅是调整超参数。较低的 VAE logSNR 对应于更平坦的局部密度景观，这往往会减少点状密度失配并提高似然导出的 PPL。然而，这种平滑也会模糊局部语义结构，并使模型偏向通用但语义上次优的延续，例如should therefore be interpreted as changing the smoothness of the latent probability space rather than merely tuning a hyperparameter. Lower VAE logSNR corresponds to a flatter local density landscape, which tends to reduce pointwise density mismatch and improve likelihood-derived PPL. However, such smoothing can also blur local semantic structure and bias the model toward generic but semantically suboptimal continuations, such asin, 的the, 或, or去了went。相比之下，直接训练会产生更差的似然导出 PPL，但有时会保留更合适的语义行为，例如正确生成. By contrast, direct training yields much worse likelihood-derived PPL, but sometimes preserves more appropriate semantic behavior, such as correctly generating她her.

5.2 第一代模块中调节和填充策略的影响Impact of Conditioning and Padding Strategies in the First Generation Block

在第一生成块中，输入包含已知的提示潜在变量和要生成的未知潜在变量。图In the first generation block, the input contains both known prompt latents and unknown latents to be generated. Figure12说明了处理该混合区域的四种代表性策略。部分重绘在已知区域注入时间步长匹配的噪声指导，其中illustrates four representative strategies for handling this mixed region. Partial repaint injects timestep-matched noisy guidance on the known region, wherett控制重绘重复次数和controls the number of repaint repetitions andmm控制接收此类指导的去噪轨迹的部分。相反，清洁条件重绘将已知区域固定为整个去噪过程中的清洁指导。相比之下，左右填充不会显式地重新绘制已知区域，而只会更改其相对于生成区域的位置布局。值得注意的是，在随机长度设置下，所有上述调节模式在训练和推理之间保持严格的一致性。controls the fraction of the denoising trajectory that receives such guidance. Clean condition repaint instead keeps the known region fixed as clean guidance throughout denoising. By contrast, left and right padding do not explicitly repaint the known region, but only change its positional layout relative to the generated region. Notably, under the random-length setting, all aforementioned conditioning modes maintain strict consistency between training and inference.

如表所示As shown in Table5，清洁条件重涂在所有任务中始终如一地实现最佳性能。相比之下，部分重绘的效果要弱得多，并且会减少, clean condition repaint consistently achieves the best performance across all tasks. In contrast, partial repaint is substantially weaker, and reducingmm通常会进一步降低性能，这表明缩短引导部分会使已知区域更难保留。增加重绘重复次数generally further degrades performance, indicating that shortening the guided portion makes the known region harder to preserve. Increasing the repaint repetitions fromt=1t=1 to t=3t=3也不会带来稳定的收益，这表明反复的早期修正无法弥补疲弱的调节。左右填充通常比大多数部分重绘设置更强，因为它们避免显式地对已知区域进行重新噪点，但仍然明显低于干净条件重绘。这表明仅位置布局是不够的：填充不能在整个去噪过程中提供稳定的条件，并且可能进一步使块因果注意力模式复杂化。also does not bring stable gains, suggesting that repeated early corrections cannot compensate for weak conditioning. Left and right padding are often stronger than most partial repaint settings because they avoid explicitly re-noising the known region, but still remain clearly below clean condition repaint. This suggests that positional layout alone is insufficient: padding does not provide a stable condition throughout denoising, and may further complicate the block-causal attention pattern.

总的来说，这些结果表明第一代块的关键挑战是在生成剩余未知部分的同时保留提示条件区域。对于这种混合去噪问题，强而持久的调节比部分噪声校正或单独的位置布局更有效。附录中提供了更多详细信息Overall, these results show that the key challenge of the first generation block is to preserve the prompt-conditioned region while generating the remaining unknown part. For this mixed denoising problem, strong and persistent conditioning is more effective than partial noisy correction or positional layout alone. More details are provided in Appendix17.1.

Under this view, moderate compression can be beneficial because each latent summarizes a larger textual span and thus better matches the role of the prior.

我们从重建的角度进一步分析 VAE 潜在空间的鲁棒性。如图We further analyze the robustness of the VAE latent space from the reconstruction perspective. As shown in Figure13，VAE 实现了近乎完美的重建, the VAE achieves nearly perfect reconstruction att=0t=0，表明学习到的潜在文本映射保持高度忠实并且不会崩溃。此外，重建精度在整个低噪声范围内保持非常高，并且仍然保持在, indicating that the learned latent–text mapping remains highly faithful and does not collapse. Moreover, the reconstruction accuracy stays very high throughout the low-noise regime, and still remains around0.920.92 at t=250t=250，然后在较重的噪音下会更明显地退化。, before degrading more noticeably under heavier noise.

这些结果表明，VAE 学习到的潜在空间不仅仅是脆弱的压缩代码，而且是稳定且广泛可用的文本中间表示。特别是，优雅的退化模式表明语义信息不会被小或中等的扰动突然破坏，这进一步支持了以下观点：VAE 潜在空间These results suggest that the latent space learned by the VAE is not merely a fragile compressed code, but a stable and broadly usable intermediate representation for text. In particular, the graceful degradation pattern indicates that semantic information is not destroyed abruptly by small or moderate perturbations, which further supports the view that the VAE latent space in𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM足够鲁棒，可以作为后续先前建模的语义接口。is sufficiently robust to serve as the semantic interface for subsequent prior modeling.

5.5 迈向图像模态的统一方法Towards a Unified Approach with Image Modalities

更广泛的含义A broader implication of𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM是它提供了从离散文本到连续多模态建模的天然桥梁。统一建模的关键思想不仅仅是将文本和图像放入一个主干中，而是将异构观察映射到共享的连续潜在交互空间中，在该空间中可以在共同的动态下组织更高层次的语义。is that it provides a natural bridge from discrete text to continuous multimodal modeling. The key idea of unified modeling is not merely to place text and image into one backbone, but to map heterogeneous observations into a shared continuous latent interaction space, where higher-level semantics can be organized under common dynamics.

的自然延伸A natural extension of𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM遵循与纯文本设置中相同的概率分解。让follows the same probabilistic decomposition as in the text-only setting. Letxtextx^{\text{text}}和andximgx^{\text{img}}表示文本和图像观察，并让它们特定于模态的潜在变量为denote the text and image observations, and let their modality-specific latent variables be

然后我们定义一个联合潜在状态We then define a joint latent state

z~0=(z0text,z0img),\tilde{z}_{0}=\bigl(z^{\text{text}}_{0},z^{\text{img}}_{0}\bigr),

并将统一生成过程建模为and model the unified generative process as

p​(xtext,ximg,z~0)=pθ​(xtext,ximg∣z~0)​pψ​(z~0).p(x^{\text{text}},x^{\text{img}},\tilde{z}_{0})=p_{\theta}\!\left(x^{\text{text}},x^{\text{img}}\mid\tilde{z}_{0}\right)\,p_{\psi}(\tilde{z}_{0}).

在这种观点下，特定于模态的 VAE 编码器和解码器负责表面级表示和实现，而共享先验模型则对潜在空间中的更高层语义结构和跨模态依赖性进行建模。Under this view, modality-specific VAE encoders and decoders are responsible for surface-level representation and realization, while the shared prior models the higher-level semantic structure and cross-modal dependency in latent space.

这个观点与中心建模原则是一致的This perspective is consistent with the central modeling principle of𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM。在 Cola DLM 中，扩散不用于 token 级观察恢复，而是用于潜在的先验传输：. In Cola DLM, diffusion is not used for token-level observation recovery, but for latent prior transport:

z1∼p1,z0=Φ0←1ψ​(z1),x∼pθ​(x∣z0).z_{1}\sim p_{1},\qquad z_{0}=\Phi^{\psi}_{0\leftarrow 1}(z_{1}),\qquad x\sim p_{\theta}(x\mid z_{0}).

在统一设置中，相同的想法扩展到多模态潜在状态In the unified setting, the same idea extends to the multimodal latent statez~0\tilde{z}_{0}：共享的块因果 MMDiT 先验传输和组织联合潜在语义，而特定于模态的解码器处理最终的文本或图像实现。因此，连续性是在先前建模的层面上引入的，而不是直接的令牌或像素恢复。: the shared block-causal MMDiT prior transports and organizes the joint latent semantics, while the modality-specific decoders handle the final text or image realization. Therefore, continuity is introduced at the level of prior modeling rather than direct token or pixel recovery.

从 ELBO 的角度来看，这种分解的好处在概念上也是显而易见的。统一的潜变量目标采用以下形式From the ELBO viewpoint, the benefit of such a decomposition is also conceptually clear. A unified latent-variable objective takes the form

𝔼​[ℒELBO]=𝔼q​[log⁡pθ​(xtext,ximg∣z~0)]−I​((Xtext,Ximg);Z~0)−KL​(q¯​(z~0)∥pψ​(z~0)),\mathbb{E}[\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{ELBO}}]=\mathbb{E}_{q}\!\left[\log p_{\theta}(x^{\text{text}},x^{\text{img}}\mid\tilde{z}_{0})\right]-I\!\left((X^{\text{text}},X^{\text{img}});\tilde{Z}_{0}\right)-\mathrm{KL}\!\left(\bar{q}(\tilde{z}_{0})\,\|\,p_{\psi}(\tilde{z}_{0})\right),

这显示了与纯文本情况相同的分工：潜在变量携带压缩的全局语义，而解码器负责特定于模态的实现。从这个意义上说，统一建模不仅仅是跨模态的参数共享，而是优于异构观察的共享语义。which shows the same division of labor as in the text-only case: the latent variable carries compressed global semantics, while the decoder is responsible for modality-specific realization. In this sense, unified modeling is not simply parameter sharing across modalities, but a shared semantic prior over heterogeneous observations.

图Figure14提出了这个想法的初步原型。在当前的设计中，文本序列被分成块，而潜在图像被视为单个大块。具体来说，图像表示是通过在内部多分辨率数据（256 / 384 / 640 / 1024）上训练的图像 VAE 获得的，空间下采样因子为 16 和 64 个潜在通道，为视觉内容提供紧凑但富有表现力的潜在空间。共享块因果 MMDiT 先验对文本块和图像潜在物进行操作，支持模内处理以及跨模态交互。在统一的框架内，这可以实现文本到文本的延续、图像条件文本生成和文本到图像生成。我们在训练期间在内部图像-文本对上共同优化这些任务。对于文本到图像任务，我们首先在 256 分辨率数据上训练 80k 步骤，全局批量大小约为 3k，然后继续在 640 分辨率数据上训练 10k 步骤，全局批量大小约为 1k。对于图像条件文本生成，我们采用相同的批量大小配置并训练大约 50k 步骤。更多结果样本提供于presents a preliminary prototype of this idea. In the current design, the text sequence is divided into blocks, while the image latent is treated as a single large block. Specifically, the image representation is obtained via an Image VAE trained on internal multi-resolution data (256 / 384 / 640 / 1024), with a spatial downsampling factor of 16 and 64 latent channels, providing a compact yet expressive latent space for visual content. The shared block-causal MMDiT prior operates over both text blocks and image latents, supporting intra-modal processing as well as cross-modal interaction. Within a unified framework, this enables text-to-text continuation, image-conditioned text generation, and text-to-image generation. We jointly optimize these tasks on internal image–text pairs during training. For the text-to-image task, we first train on 256-resolution data for 80k steps with a global batch size of approximately 3k, and then continue training on 640-resolution data for 10k steps with a global batch size of approximately 1k. For image-conditioned text generation, we adopt the same batch size configuration and train for approximately 50k steps. More result samples are provided at17.2.

这些结果应主要被解释为可行性的定性证据。由于当前的原型仍处于训练的早期阶段，我们的实验仅限于对内部 256 和 640 分辨率数据进行适度的预训练，没有广泛的高质量数据管理或监督微调。本节的目标不是提出一个成熟的多式联运系统。相反，它是为了证明分层潜在先验表述These results should be interpreted primarily as qualitative evidence of feasibility. As the current prototype remains at an early stage of training, and our experiments are limited to moderate pretraining on in-house 256 and 640 resolution data, without extensive high-quality data curation or supervised fine-tuning. The goal of this section is not to present a mature multimodal system. Rather, it is to demonstrate that the hierarchical latent-prior formulation of𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM自然地扩展到纯文本生成之外。在今后的工作中，我们计划开展更加全面的统一多式联运培训。更广泛地说，这些发现表明，将全局潜在组织与特定模态的实现脱钩可能会为更原生的统一生成模型提供结构上干净且可扩展的路径。naturally extends beyond text-only generation. In future work, we plan to conduct more comprehensive unified multimodal training. More broadly, these findings suggest that decoupling global latent organization from modality-specific realization may offer a structurally clean and scalable path toward more native unified generative models.

6 局限性和未来前景Limitations & Future Prospects

尽管本文为可行性、竞争力和有希望的扩展潜力提供了初步证据Although this paper has provided initial evidence for the feasibility, competitiveness, and promising scaling potential of𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM对于连续潜在空间中的文本生成，我们将其视为进一步探索的起点，而不是完成的终点。首先，在规模和评估层面，目前的结果显示出令人鼓舞的趋势，但实验仍然是在相对受控的规模下进行的，主要用于阐明框架的关键属性。因此，在更大的模型大小、更长的训练和更大量的计算预算下进一步检查其上限是自然而重要的。其次，在模型设计层面，我们的分析表明，文本VAE的训练策略、文本压缩方案、潜在维度的选择、潜在空间的语义平滑度以及VAE logSNR、DiT块大小和噪声调度的联合校准都会影响潜在空间的语义组织和最终的生成质量。特别是，实验表明更强的潜在表示通常需要更好对齐的噪声校准，这表明进一步优化的空间很大。最后，在框架层面，主要价值for text generation in continuous latent space, we view it as a starting point for further exploration rather than a finished endpoint. First, at the scale and evaluation level, the current results reveal encouraging trends, but the experiments are still conducted at a relatively controlled scale and mainly serve to clarify the key properties of the framework. It is therefore natural and important to further examine its upper bound under larger model sizes, longer training, and more substantial compute budgets. Second, at the model-design level, our analyses show that the training strategy of the Text VAE, the text compression scheme, the choice of latent dimensionality, the semantic smoothness of the latent space, and the joint calibration of VAE logSNR, DiT block size, and noise schedule all affect the semantic organization of the latent space and the final generation quality. In particular, the experiments suggest that stronger latent representations usually require better-aligned noise calibration, indicating substantial room for further optimization. Finally, at the framework level, the main value of𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM不仅在于去噪过程本身，还在于它将文本生成分解为全局语义先验建模和局部文本实现。这为探索更强大的潜在模块（例如 AE）打开了大门lies not merely in the denoising process itself, but in its decomposition of text generation into global semantic prior modeling and local textual realization. This opens the door to exploring stronger latent modules, such as AE[5]和RAEand RAE[112]，以及更灵活的先验学习方法，例如基于漂移模型, as well as more flexible prior-learning approaches, such as drifting-model-based[19]连续先验的分布匹配。更广泛地说，遵循统一连续潜在空间建模的思想，该框架还可以扩展到图像等连续模态，进一步推进统一生成。distribution matching for continuous priors. More broadly, following the idea of unified continuous latent-space modeling, the framework may also be extended to continuous modalities such as images, further advancing unified generation.

7 结论Conclusion

总之，本文提出In conclusion, this paper presents𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM，一种分层连续潜在扩散语言模型，它将文本生成分解为潜在空间中的全局语义先验建模和通过条件解码的局部文本实现，从而为严格的令牌级语言建模提供了原则上的替代方案。在整个研究中，理论分析和实验一致表明文本生成可以受益于分层信息分解：我们发现潜在空间中共享全局语义结构的证据，确定潜在空间形成和扩散建模的有效设计选择，并表明在严格匹配的比较下，, a hierarchical continuous latent diffusion language model that decomposes text generation into global semantic prior modeling in latent space and local textual realization through conditional decoding, thereby providing a principled alternative to strictly token-level language modeling. Across the full study, both the theoretical analysis and the experiments consistently suggest that text generation can benefit from hierarchical information decomposition: we find evidence of shared global semantic structure in latent space, identify effective design choices for latent-space formation and diffusion modeling, and show that under strictly matched comparisons,𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM表现出强大的生成质量和令人鼓舞的扩展行为。更广泛地说，我们的结果表明，对于此类模型，面向生成的评估和缩放趋势可能比单独的可能性提供更多信息，而连续潜在公式也提供了跨离散文本和连续模态的更原生统一建模的具体路径。exhibits strong generation quality and encouraging scaling behavior. More broadly, our results indicate that for this class of models, generation-oriented evaluation and scaling trends may be more informative than likelihood alone, while the continuous latent formulation also offers a concrete path toward more native unified modeling across discrete text and continuous modalities.

8 后记：研究目的及意义Afterword: Research Objectives and Significance

从更广泛的角度来看，这项研究不仅涉及提出一种文本生成的替代架构，而且还阐明了更一般的学习图景，其中Viewed from a broader perspective, this study is not only concerned with proposing an alternative architecture for text generation, but also with clarifying a more general picture of learning in which代表性representation, 目标objective, 和, and环境environment必须共同理解。从这个角度来看，这部作品的三个主题是紧密相连的而不是独立的。第一个涉及如何表示和生成文本。第二个问题涉及什么样的目标和评价标准真正符合这种表述。第三个问题涉及模型最终应该学习的环境类型，如果目标是更通用的多模态智能。must be understood jointly. From this perspective, the three themes of this work are closely connected rather than independent. The first concerns how text should be represented and generated. The second concerns what kinds of objectives and evaluation criteria are genuinely aligned with such representations. The third concerns the kind of environment in which a model should ultimately learn if the goal is more general multimodal intelligence.

一个有用的起点是将学习本身形式化为模型-环境交互系统。让环境成为A useful starting point is to formalize learning itself as a model–environment interaction system. Let the environment be

ℰ=(Ω,𝒪,𝒜,𝒯,ℱ,𝒢),\mathcal{E}=(\Omega,\mathcal{O},\mathcal{A},\mathcal{T},\mathcal{F},\mathcal{G}), (8.1)

哪里whereΩ\Omega是环境状态空间，is the environment state space,𝒪\mathcal{O}是观测空间，is the observation space,𝒜\mathcal{A}是动作或输出空间，is the action or output space,𝒯\mathcal{T}是状态转换机制，is the state transition mechanism,ℱ\mathcal{F}是反馈生成机制，并且is the feedback generation mechanism, and𝒢\mathcal{G}是将反馈转化为优化信号的规则。重要的是，这里的环境概念是广义的：它不仅包括外部世界，还包括呈现给模型的数据分布、任务格式、监督协议，甚至包括将反馈转化为梯度的损失规则。is the rule that converts feedback into optimization signals. Importantly, the notion of environment is understood here in a broad sense: it includes not only the external world, but also the data distribution presented to the model, task formats, supervision protocols, and even the loss rules by which feedback is transformed into gradients.

令模型表示为Let the model be denoted byMθM_{\theta}，具有内部状态空间, with internal state spaceℋ\mathcal{H}，状态更新图, state update mapUθU_{\theta}，以及政策或生成图, and policy or generation mapΠθ\Pi_{\theta}。在交互步骤. At interaction steptt，闭环系统可写为, the closed-loop system can be written as

这种形式化直接表明学习从来都不是模型结构的孤立问题。相反，它是由三个因素共同决定的：一是模型吸收和组织信息的状态空间；二是模型吸收和组织信息的状态空间。其次，环境通过何种反馈来定义改进；第三，产生观察、转换和反馈的实际结构。在这项工作中，这三个方面恰好对应了论文的三个反复出现的主题：文本应该如何表示、哪些指标与真正的学习目标一致、以及最终要进入什么样的环境统一模型。This formalization shows directly that learning is never an isolated question of model structure alone. Rather, it is jointly determined by three factors: first, the state space in which the model absorbs and organizes information; second, the kind of feedback through which the environment defines improvement; and third, the actual structure that generates observations, transitions, and feedback. In this work, these three aspects correspond precisely to the three recurring themes of the paper: how text should be represented, which metrics are aligned with the true learning objective, and what kind of environment unified models are ultimately meant to enter.

8.1 重新思考文本建模范式：从系统中的状态空间到分层文本生成Rethinking Text Modeling Paradigms: From State Space in the System to Hierarchical Text Generation

从系统层面来看，文本建模的核心问题不仅仅是采用哪种生成顺序，而是采用什么样的生成顺序。From a system-level perspective, the central question of text modeling is not merely which generation order to adopt, but rather in what kind of状态state文本应该在学习系统中呈现。主流自回归语言模型将状态紧密地绑定到表面标记前缀，因此生成被写为text should be represented within the learning system. Mainstream autoregressive language models bind the state tightly to the surface token prefix, and generation is therefore written as

pAR​(x)=∏t=1npθ​(xt∣x<t).p_{\mathrm{AR}}(x)=\prod_{t=1}^{n}p_{\theta}(x_{t}\mid x_{<t}). (8.9)

这种分解非常有效，但它从根本上对应于一个强大的建模假设：全局语义和局部实现都通过相同的令牌级条件链传播。换句话说，它假设表面弦本身是最自然、最原始的状态空间。This factorization is highly effective, but it fundamentally corresponds to a strong modeling assumption: both global semantics and local realization are propagated through the same token-level conditional chain. In other words, it assumes that the surface string itself is the most natural and primary state space.

本文探索的路线而是从状态空间本身的层面重新考虑文本生成。如果文本确实包含低维但足够有用的全局语义结构，那么更自然的方法不是将生成的全部负担放在令牌级链分解上，而是显式引入潜在变量并与本地文本实现分开建模高级语义组织。相应地，核心因式分解The route explored in this paper instead reconsiders text generation from the level of the state space itself. If text indeed contains a low-dimensional yet sufficiently useful global semantic structure, then a more natural approach is not to place the entire burden of generation on a token-level chain factorization, but to introduce latent variables explicitly and model high-level semantic organization separately from local textual realization. Correspondingly, the core factorization of𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM is

p​(x,z0)=pθ​(x∣z0)​pψ​(z0),p​(x)=∫pθ​(x∣z0)​pψ​(z0)​𝑑z0,p(x,z_{0})=p_{\theta}(x\mid z_{0})p_{\psi}(z_{0}),\qquad p(x)=\int p_{\theta}(x\mid z_{0})p_{\psi}(z_{0})\,dz_{0}, (8.10)

哪里wherez0z_{0}是连续潜变量，is a continuous latent variable,pψ​(z0)p_{\psi}(z_{0})是潜在的先验，并且is the latent prior, andpθ​(x∣z0)p_{\theta}(x\mid z_{0})是条件解码器。这里关键的变化不仅仅是引入潜在变量，而是重新定义了状态在系统中的作用：路径不再直接作用于观察恢复，而是首先在潜在空间中组织全局语义，然后解码器进行本地文本实现。is the conditional decoder. The crucial change here is not merely the introduction of latent variables, but the redefinition of the role of state in the system: the path no longer acts directly on observation recovery, but instead organizes global semantics in latent space first, after which the decoder carries out local textual realization.

这一点可以通过平均 ELBO 的信息分解来简洁地表述。让This point can be stated compactly through the information decomposition of the average ELBO. Let

q​(x,z0):=pdata​(x)​qϕ​(z0∣x),q(x,z_{0}):=p_{\mathrm{data}}(x)q_{\phi}(z_{0}\mid x), (8.11)

然后then

𝔼pdata​(x)​[ℒELBO​(x)]=𝔼q​(x,z0)​[log⁡pθ​(x∣z0)]−Iq​(X;Z0)−KL​(q¯ϕ​(z0)∥pψ​(z0)),\mathbb{E}_{p_{\mathrm{data}}(x)}[\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{ELBO}}(x)]=\mathbb{E}_{q(x,z_{0})}[\log p_{\theta}(x\mid z_{0})]-I_{q}(X;Z_{0})-\mathrm{KL}\!\big(\bar{q}_{\phi}(z_{0})\,\|\,p_{\psi}(z_{0})\big), (8.12)

哪里whereq¯ϕ​(z0)\bar{q}_{\phi}(z_{0})是聚合后验。这种分解表明，分层潜在空间建模将文本问题分解为三个耦合但在分析上可区分的组成部分：条件实现、信息压缩和先验匹配。因此，潜在变量不仅仅是离散标记的连续代理，而且是一个显式的中间状态，通过它全局语义组织可以与本地文本实现分离并根据其自己的术语进行建模。is the aggregated posterior. This decomposition shows that hierarchical latent-space modeling breaks the text problem into three coupled but analytically distinguishable components: conditional realization, information compression, and prior matching. The latent variable is therefore not merely a continuous surrogate for discrete tokens, but an explicit intermediate state through which global semantic organization can be separated from local textual realization and modeled on its own terms.

从这个角度来看，压缩也必须重新考虑。先前的工作强调了压缩和智能之间的联系From this perspective, compression must also be reconsidered. Prior work has emphasized the connection between compression and intelligence[37]，而最近对生成更接近图像和视频中的原始数据形式的探索，例如像素空间建模, while recent explorations of generation closer to raw data forms in images and videos, such as pixel-space modeling[19]，进一步建议压缩不应等同于有害信息删除。关键问题不在于是否保留了每个局部细节，而在于模型是否能够提取和组织真正有效且可泛化的结构信息。如果文本确实承认高层语义和低层实现相对分离的层次结构，那么通过信息层次重新解释文本生成不仅仅是方法的改变，而是对文本建模本身的理论上的重新评估。, further suggest that compression should not be equated with harmful information deletion. The key question is not whether every local detail is preserved, but whether the model can extract and organize structural information that is genuinely effective and generalizable. If text indeed admits a hierarchical structure in which high-level semantics and low-level realization are relatively separable, then reinterpreting text generation through informational hierarchy is not merely a change of method, but a theoretical re-evaluation of text modeling itself.

因此，本文的第一个主题不是拒绝自回归，而是指出自回归仅占据设计空间的一个自洽而非唯一的角落。如果数据确实包含低维全局语义和高维局部实现之间的层次结构，那么首先在潜在状态中组织语义并通过条件解码实现文本可能更接近真正的生成机制。因此，文本生成不应仅仅被理解为离散字符串上的下一个标记拟合，而更普遍地被理解为如何分层表示、压缩和组织信息的系统问题。Accordingly, the first theme of this paper is not to reject autoregression, but to point out that autoregression occupies only one self-consistent, rather than unique, corner of the design space. If the data truly contains a hierarchy between low-dimensional global semantics and high-dimensional local realization, then organizing semantics first in a latent state and realizing text through conditional decoding may be closer to the true generative mechanism. Text generation should therefore not be understood solely as next-token fitting over discrete strings, but more generally as a systematic problem of how information is represented, compressed, and organized hierarchically.

8.2 理解离散文本的持续延伸：从客观不匹配到评价重点的转变Understanding the Continuous Extension of Discrete Text: From Objective Mismatch to a Shift in Evaluation Emphasis

一旦系统的状态空间发生变化，客观层面的问题就会发生相应的变化。对于传统的自回归语言模型，训练目标和评估量自然是很好地对齐的：最大似然训练直接对应于文本的概率拟合，因此似然和困惑度有一个清晰稳定的解释。然而，在分层连续潜在空间模型中，实际的训练路径不再是直接的标记级最大似然，而是由重建、潜在先验学习和表示正则化共同组成的分层目标。Once the state space of the system is changed, the issue at the objective level changes accordingly. For conventional autoregressive language models, the training objective and evaluation quantities are naturally well aligned: maximum likelihood training directly corresponds to probability fitting over text, and likelihood and perplexity therefore have a clear and stable interpretation. In hierarchical continuous latent-space models, however, the actual training path is no longer direct token-level maximum likelihood, but a hierarchical objective jointly composed of reconstruction, latent prior learning, and representation regularization.

这可以从 ELBO 与真实边际似然的关系看出：This can be seen from the relation between the ELBO and the true marginal likelihood:

−ℒELBO(x)=−logpθ,ψ(x)+KL(qϕ(z0∣x)∥pθ,ψ(z0∣x)).-\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{ELBO}}(x)=-\log p_{\theta,\psi}(x)+\mathrm{KL}\!\big(q_{\phi}(z_{0}\mid x)\,\|\,p_{\theta,\psi}(z_{0}\mid x)\big). (8.13)

这表明，即使在 ELBO 级别，训练目标也已经通过变分推理间隙与真实的对数似然分开。另外，在实际训练中This shows that even at the level of the ELBO, the training objective is already separated from the true log-likelihood by a variational inference gap. Furthermore, in the actual training of𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM，模型必须共同学习潜在重建、连续先验拟合和表示稳定。因此，被优化的数量不是经典意义上的单个令牌级别的可能性。, the model must jointly learn latent reconstruction, continuous prior fitting, and representation stabilization. The quantity being optimized is therefore not a single token-level likelihood in the classical sense.

因此，不匹配不应被解释为学习失败，而应被视为模型正在学习不同内容的证据。对于直接拟合离散分布的自回归模型和其他范式，似然性和困惑度仍然具有很高的信息量，因为它们自然地与训练目标保持一致。相比之下，对于分层连续潜在空间模型，中心问题不再是局部离散分布是否尽可能精确地拟合，而是更高层次的语义结构是否有效组织，潜在先验是否得到很好的学习，以及最终生成是否满足实际任务要求。For this reason, the mismatch should not be interpreted as a failure to learn, but rather as evidence that the model is learning something different. For autoregressive models and other paradigms that directly fit discrete distributions, likelihood and perplexity remain highly informative because they are naturally aligned with the training objective. For hierarchical continuous latent-space models, by contrast, the central issue is no longer whether local discrete distributions are fitted as sharply as possible, but whether higher-level semantic structures are effectively organized, whether the latent prior is well learned, and whether the final generations satisfy the actual task requirements.

从系统建模的角度来看，这种现象实际上是预料之中的：当状态空间从表面标记扩展到分层潜在变量时，优化目标相应地从局部离散分布的精确拟合转向更高层语义结构的组织、稳定的潜在先验学习和满足真实生成目标。因此，对于这条路线，面向生成的指标通常比困惑度更符合模型实际训练的目的。更重要的是，模型潜力通常比任何单个静态似然值更清楚地反映在缩放行为中：重要的是随着模型大小、数据和计算的增加，能力是否持续稳定提高，而不是特定逐点指标下的局部拟合是否更好。From the perspective of systematic modeling, this phenomenon is in fact expected: when the state space expands from surface tokens to hierarchical latent variables, the optimization target correspondingly shifts from precise fitting of local discrete distributions to the organization of higher-level semantic structure, stable latent prior learning, and satisfaction of the true generative objective. For this route, generation-oriented metrics are therefore often more closely aligned with what the model is actually trained to do than perplexity. More importantly, model potential is often reflected more clearly in scaling behavior than in any single static likelihood value: what matters is whether capability continues to improve steadily as model size, data, and compute increase, rather than whether local fit under a particular pointwise metric is better.

这也可以与本文理论分析中提出的三个控制曲线的观点联系起来。对于This can also be connected to the perspective of the three governing curves developed in the theoretical analysis of the paper. For𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM，这条路线的适用性不是由单个似然值决定的，而是由三个条件是否同时成立决定的：表征率-失真曲线在相对较低的速率下已经是有利的，潜在先验的逼近误差持续减小，推理差距仍然可控。换句话说，这条路线的优势并不是由潜在变量或基于流的建模本身自动保证的；这取决于数据是否真正包含可压缩的全局语义结构，以及模型是否能够稳定地学习、拟合和实现该结构。, the applicability of this route is not determined by a single likelihood value, but by whether three conditions hold simultaneously: the representation rate–distortion curve is already favorable at relatively low rate, the approximation error of the latent prior continues to decrease, and the inference gap remains controllable. In other words, the advantage of this route is not guaranteed automatically by latent variables or flow-based modeling themselves; it depends on whether the data truly contains a compressible global semantic structure, and whether the model can learn, fit, and realize that structure in a stable manner.

因此，本文的第二个主题不仅是困惑度不够，而且一旦表征和目标发生变化，评估语言本身也必须改变。对于此类模型，生成质量和扩展行为通常比传统的困惑度更接近模型的真实能力和长期潜力。The second theme of this paper is therefore not merely that perplexity is inadequate, but that evaluation language itself must change once representation and objective have changed. For this class of models, generation quality and scaling behavior are often closer to the model’s true capability and long-term potential than traditional perplexity.

8.3 探索统一模型：模型-环境交互和多模态统一的价值Exploring Unified Models: Model-Environment Interaction and the Value of Multimodal Unification

如果我们再次回到方程中的模型-环境形式化。 （If we return again to the model–environment formalization in Eq. (8.1）和等式。 （) and Eq. (8.8），第三主题变得更加自然。统一模型的重要性不仅仅在于将多种模态放置在单个参数化网络中，还在于改变模型学习的环境结构。在现实世界中，观察、转换和反馈通常不是跨模式独立生成的；相反，它们通常是由共享的潜在状态共同决定的。因此，更通用的学习系统不需要一组并排放置的孤立模态接口，而是需要可以进入相同交互状态并共享相同动态约束的统一表示。), the third theme becomes more natural. The importance of unified models does not lie merely in placing multiple modalities within a single parameterized network, but in changing the structure of the environment in which the model learns. In the real world, observations, transitions, and feedback are usually not generated independently across modalities; rather, they are often jointly determined by a shared latent state. A more general learning system therefore requires not a set of isolated modality interfaces placed side by side, but unified representations that can enter the same interaction state and share the same dynamical constraints.

这与两种更广泛的情报观点密切相关。一种有影响力的观点将智力理解为跨任务技能的集合This is closely related to two broader views of intelligence. One influential view understands intelligence as a collection of skills across tasks[16]。在这种观点下，系统变得更加强大，因为它可以跨更多领域、在更多样化的监督和交互形式下解决问题。最近大型语言模型的发展部分反映了这种趋势。一个代表性的例子是可以在命令行环境中运行的代码代理的进展。在这样的环境中，观察空间、行动空间和反馈机制与离散的符号表示异常地一致。交互轨迹很容易记录，正确性通常很容易验证，因此这些环境提供了密集且精确的学习信号。. Under this view, a system becomes more capable because it can solve problems across more domains and under more diverse forms of supervision and interaction. The recent development of large language models partly reflects this tendency. A representative example is the progress of code agents that can operate within command-line environments. In such environments, the observation space, action space, and feedback mechanism are unusually well aligned with discrete symbolic representations. Interaction trajectories are easy to record, and correctness is often straightforward to verify, so these environments provide dense and precise learning signals.

另一种更接近世界模型观点的观点认为，智能在于获取世界结构和动态的内部模型。世界模型的最新工作Another view, closer to the world-model perspective, holds that intelligence consists in acquiring an internal model of the structure and dynamics of the world. Recent work on world models[93]通过寻求学习更丰富的环境动态，从而支持更强的泛化和更现实的交互，朝着这个方向前进。从这个角度来看，问题不仅在于模型可以解决多少任务，还在于它是否在结构足够丰富以引发正确抽象的环境中学习。因此，环境变得至关重要：模型只能内化其所遇到的观察、转换和反馈中实际存在的规律性。moves in this direction by seeking to learn richer environmental dynamics, thereby supporting stronger generalization and more realistic interaction. From this perspective, the question is not only how many tasks a model can solve, but whether it learns in an environment whose structure is rich enough to induce the right abstractions. The environment therefore becomes central: a model can only internalize the regularities that are actually present in the observations, transitions, and feedback it encounters.

这也可以写得更正式。让观察步骤This can also be written more formally. Let the observation at steptt是多式联运的，be multimodal,

In such a case, treating each modality as an independent channel and only combining them superficially is generally insufficient. The theoretical significance of unified models lies precisely in the fact that the environment itself is non-separable in the sense of Eq. (8.17）：决定有用反馈的规律是联合规律，而不是在每种模态的边际分布上定义的规律。): the regularities that determine useful feedback are joint regularities rather than regularities defined on the marginal distribution of each modality.

这阐明了为什么多模态统一不仅仅是工程上的便利。其目的不仅仅是用一个主干处理多种数据类型，而是让模型在一个观察、转换和监督结构更忠实地反映现实世界耦合规律的环境中学习。在这样的环境中，输入和输出都可能是多模式的；有用的反馈可能取决于不同模式如何相互制约；理想情况下，学习到的内部状态应该反映这些联合约束。This clarifies why multimodal unification is not merely an engineering convenience. Its purpose is not simply to process multiple data types with one backbone, but to allow the model to learn in an environment whose observation, transition, and supervision structure more faithfully reflects the coupled regularities of the real world. In such an environment, both inputs and outputs may be multimodal; useful feedback may depend on how different modalities constrain each other jointly; and the learned internal state should ideally reflect these joint constraints.

这也解释了为什么文本长期以来一直是统一模型中最困难的组成部分。图像和视频自然地在连续空间中运行，而文本是典型的离散模式。如果他们要进入共同的交互状态并共享潜在的动态，就会立即出现严重的表征不匹配。这正是最近统一模型研究中反复发现的主要障碍之一This also explains why text has long been the most difficult component in unified models. Images and videos naturally operate in continuous spaces, whereas text is a prototypically discrete modality. If they are to enter a common interaction state and share latent dynamics, a severe representational mismatch immediately arises. This is precisely one of the central obstacles repeatedly identified in recent unified-model research[18]。从这个意义上说，意义. 8.4 统一视角下的三大主题The Three Themes Under a Unified Perspective

综上所述，本文的三个主题并不是单独的补充讨论，而是同一系统问题的三种表现。第一个涉及In summary, the three themes of this paper are not separate supplementary discussions, but three manifestations of the same systematic problem. The first concerns the代表性水平representation level：文本是否应该完全在令牌表面上建模，或者是否可以在独立的潜在状态中组织更高级别的语义。第二个涉及: whether text should be modeled entirely on the token surface, or whether higher-level semantics can be organized in an independent latent state. The second concerns the客观水平objective level：一旦模型通过潜在传输、重建和正则化而不是直接的标记级最大似然进行训练，这些指标就与学习问题真正保持一致。第三个涉及: once the model is trained through latent transport, reconstruction, and regularization rather than direct token-level maximum likelihood, which metrics remain genuinely aligned with the learning problem. The third concerns the环境等级environment level：如果学习最终是模型与环境的交互，那么未来的模型应该居住在什么样的环境中，以及不同模态需要什么样的表征接口才能在其中兼容。: if learning is ultimately model–environment interaction, then what kind of environment future models should inhabit, and what representational interfaces are needed for different modalities to become compatible within it.

从这个角度来看，自回归语言建模占据了设计空间的自洽角落：表示与表面标记紧密结合，训练目标是直接似然最大化，并且环境主要是符号和以文本为中心的。这项工作探索的路线同时改变了所有三个假设。它引入了文本的分层潜变量表示，从而改变了表示假设；它使优化远离直接的标记级可能性，从而削弱了困惑度的核心解释作用；它为离散文本提供了连续的接口，从而使文本与在连续潜在空间中更自然地表达的多模态环境更加兼容。From this perspective, autoregressive language modeling occupies a self-consistent corner of the design space: representation is tightly bound to surface tokens, the training objective is direct likelihood maximization, and the environment is largely symbolic and text-centered. The route explored in this work changes all three assumptions simultaneously. It introduces a hierarchical latent-variable representation for text, thereby changing the representational assumption; it moves optimization away from direct token-level likelihood, thereby weakening the central interpretive role of perplexity; and it provides a continuous interface for discrete text, thereby making text potentially more compatible with multimodal environments that are more naturally expressed in continuous latent space.

因此，我们希望这项工作的贡献不仅是文本生成的可行替代路径，而且是一种更系统的思维方式，共同考虑表示、目标对齐和环境设计。更广泛地说，我们希望它鼓励未来的研究重新思考文本、图像、视频和其他模式，不要将其视为必须单独解决的孤立领域，而是将其视为更大学习系统的组成部分，在该系统中，统一表示、统一目标和统一环境可能成为更通用的多模态智能发展的中心。We therefore hope that the contribution of this work is not only a viable alternative path for text generation, but also a more systematic way of thinking that jointly considers representation, objective alignment, and environment design. More broadly, we hope it encourages future research to rethink text, images, videos, and other modalities not as isolated domains that must be solved separately, but as components of a larger learning system in which unified representation, unified objectives, and unified environments may become increasingly central to the development of more general multimodal intelligence.

9 Cola DLM 的严格概率制定和训练目标细节Strict Probabilistic Formulation and Training Objective Details of Cola DLM

本附录提供了严格的概率公式This appendix provides the strict probabilistic formulation of𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM并阐明了每个培训组成部分的作用。我们首先精确定义潜变量模型和 CNF 先验，然后推导边际似然、ELBO 及其总体形式，最后解释流匹配在整个理论框架中的确切作用。and clarifies the role of each training component. We first define the latent-variable model and the CNF prior precisely, then derive the marginal likelihood, the ELBO, and its population form, and finally explain the exact role of Flow Matching in the overall theoretical framework.

9.1 概率对象、CNF 先验和生成分布Probabilistic Objects, CNF Prior, and Generative Distribution

让Letx∈𝒳x\in\mathcal{X}表示离散文本序列，并让denote a discrete text sequence, and letz0∈ℝdz_{0}\in\mathbb{R}^{d}表示其连续潜变量。denote its continuous latent variable.𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM由三个概率部分组成：consists of three probabilistic components:

qϕ​(z0∣x)\displaystyle q_{\phi}(z_{0}\mid x) encoder (approximate posterior),\displaystyle\quad\text{encoder (approximate posterior)}, (9.1)
pθ​(x∣z0)\displaystyle p_{\theta}(x\mid z_{0}) decoder (conditional text generator),\displaystyle\quad\text{decoder (conditional text generator)}, (9.2)
pψ​(z0)\displaystyle p_{\psi}(z_{0}) latent prior (defined by a continuous flow).\displaystyle\quad\text{latent prior (defined by a continuous flow)}. (9.3)

在这里，Here,qϕ​(z0∣x)q_{\phi}(z_{0}\mid x)仅用于训练期间的变分推理。实际的生成分布定义为is used only for variational inference during training. The actual generative distribution is defined bypθ​(x∣z0)p_{\theta}(x\mid z_{0})和andpψ​(z0)p_{\psi}(z_{0}).

为了确保流图和密度传输公式得到明确定义，我们对 CNF 向量场施加标准正则性假设。To ensure that the flow map and density-transport formula are well defined, we impose the standard regularity assumption on the CNF vector field.

pψ=(Φ0←1ψ)♯​p1.p_{\psi}=(\Phi^{\psi}_{0\leftarrow 1})_{\sharp}p_{1}. (9.8)

9.2 CNF 先验和外 ELBO 的显式密度Explicit Density of the CNF Prior and the Outer ELBO

让LetZtZ_{t}表示 ODE 在某个时刻导出的随机变量denote the random variable induced by the ODE at timett, 与密度, with densityptp_{t}。假设下. Under Assumption9.1, ptp_{t}满足连续性方程satisfies the continuity equation

∂tpt​(z)+∇⋅(pt​(z)​𝒗ψ​(z,t))=0.\partial_{t}p_{t}(z)+\nabla\!\cdot\bigl(p_{t}(z)\,\bm{v}_{\psi}(z,t)\bigr)=0.

沿着特征轨迹Along a characteristic trajectoryt↦ztt\mapsto z_{t}，瞬时变量变化公式给出, the instantaneous change-of-variables formula gives

dd​t​log⁡pt​(zt)=−∇⋅𝒗ψ​(zt,t).\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}\log p_{t}(z_{t})=-\nabla\!\cdot\bm{v}_{\psi}(z_{t},t). (9.12)

整合自Integrating from0 to 11，并注意到, and noting thatp0=pψp_{0}=p_{\psi}，产量, yields

log⁡pψ​(z0)=log⁡p1​(z1)+∫01∇⋅𝒗ψ​(zt,t)​dt,z1=Φ1←0ψ​(z0).\log p_{\psi}(z_{0})=\log p_{1}(z_{1})+\int_{0}^{1}\nabla\!\cdot\bm{v}_{\psi}(z_{t},t)\,\mathrm{d}t,\qquad z_{1}=\Phi^{\psi}_{1\leftarrow 0}(z_{0}). (9.13)

因此，CNF 先验承认明确定义的对数密度，而不是仅通过采样存在的隐式先验。Thus, the CNF prior admits an explicitly defined log-density rather than an implicit prior that exists only through sampling.

流图也可以写成确定性马尔可夫核。定义The flow map can also be written as a deterministic Markov kernel. Define

Kt←sψ​(d​zt∣zs):=δΦt←sψ​(zs)​(d​zt).K^{\psi}_{t\leftarrow s}(\mathrm{d}z_{t}\mid z_{s}):=\delta_{\Phi^{\psi}_{t\leftarrow s}(z_{s})}(\mathrm{d}z_{t}). (9.14)

由 ODE 流的半群性质，By the semigroup property of ODE flows,Kt←sψK^{\psi}_{t\leftarrow s}满足查普曼-柯尔莫哥洛夫关系，因此形成确定性马尔可夫半群。然而，这里的马尔可夫结构来自先前的传输，而不是来自依赖于观察的损坏恢复机制。satisfies the Chapman–Kolmogorov relation and therefore forms a deterministic Markov semigroup. However, the Markov structure here comes from prior transport, not from an observation-dependent corruption–recovery mechanism.

现在我们介绍变分后验We now introduce the variational posteriorqϕ​(z0∣x)q_{\phi}(z_{0}\mid x)处理边际似然中的潜在积分。对于任何to handle the latent integral in the marginal likelihood. For anyqϕ​(z0∣x)q_{\phi}(z_{0}\mid x)满足所需的支撑条件，satisfying the required support condition,

log⁡p​(x)\displaystyle\log p(x) =log​∫qϕ​(z0∣x)​pθ​(x∣z0)​pψ​(z0)qϕ​(z0∣x)​dz0\displaystyle=\log\int q_{\phi}(z_{0}\mid x)\frac{p_{\theta}(x\mid z_{0})p_{\psi}(z_{0})}{q_{\phi}(z_{0}\mid x)}\,\mathrm{d}z_{0} (9.15)
≥𝔼qϕ​(z0∣x)​[log⁡pθ​(x∣z0)+log⁡pψ​(z0)−log⁡qϕ​(z0∣x)].\displaystyle\geq\mathbb{E}_{q_{\phi}(z_{0}\mid x)}\Bigl[\log p_{\theta}(x\mid z_{0})+\log p_{\psi}(z_{0})-\log q_{\phi}(z_{0}\mid x)\Bigr]. (9.16)

Define the outer ELBO as

ℒELBO​(x):=𝔼qϕ​(z0∣x)​[log⁡pθ​(x∣z0)+log⁡pψ​(z0)−log⁡qϕ​(z0∣x)].\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{ELBO}}(x):=\mathbb{E}_{q_{\phi}(z_{0}\mid x)}\Bigl[\log p_{\theta}(x\mid z_{0})+\log p_{\psi}(z_{0})-\log q_{\phi}(z_{0}\mid x)\Bigr]. (9.17)

然后Then

log⁡p​(x)≥ℒELBO​(x).\log p(x)\geq\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{ELBO}}(x). (9.18)
