9.4 流匹配的作用：先验求解器而不是模型定义The Role of Flow Matching: A Prior Solver Rather Than the Model Definition

直接优化Direct optimization oflog⁡pψ​(z0)\log p_{\psi}(z_{0})通常需要重复的 ODE 求解和散度估计，这在实践中是昂贵的。因此，流匹配通常用于更有效地学习相同先验的向量场。因此，它应该被视为先验求解器，而不是似然目标本身。usually requires repeated ODE solves and divergence estimation, which is expensive in practice. For this reason, Flow Matching is often used to learn the vector field of the same prior more efficiently. It should therefore be viewed as a prior solver, not as the likelihood objective itself.

为此，首先指定从聚合后验分布到基本分布的桥接路径。让To do so, one first specifies a bridge path from the aggregated posterior to the base distribution. Let

z0∼q¯ϕ​(z0),z1∼p1​(z1),t∼U​[0,1].z_{0}\sim\bar{q}_{\phi}(z_{0}),\qquad z_{1}\sim p_{1}(z_{1}),\qquad t\sim U[0,1]. (9.30)

考虑条件路径Consider the conditional path

zt=(1−α​(t))​z0+α​(t)​z1,α​(0)=0,α​(1)=1.z_{t}=(1-\alpha(t))z_{0}+\alpha(t)z_{1},\qquad\alpha(0)=0,\ \alpha(1)=1. (9.31)

这里Hereα\alpha可以是任何足够平滑的单调函数；线性插值对应于can be any sufficiently smooth monotone function; linear interpolation corresponds toα​(t)=t\alpha(t)=t。该路径的目标速度场为. The target velocity field of this path is

ut​(z0,z1):=d​ztd​t=α˙​(t)​(z1−z0).u_{t}(z_{0},z_{1}):=\frac{\mathrm{d}z_{t}}{\mathrm{d}t}=\dot{\alpha}(t)(z_{1}-z_{0}). (9.32)

则流量匹配损失为The Flow Matching loss is then

ℒFM​(ψ;ϕ):=𝔼t,z0∼q¯ϕ,z1∼p1​[‖𝒗ψ​(zt,t)−ut​(z0,z1)‖22].\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{FM}}(\psi;\phi):=\mathbb{E}_{t,\,z_{0}\sim\bar{q}_{\phi},\,z_{1}\sim p_{1}}\left[\left\|\bm{v}_{\psi}(z_{t},t)-u_{t}(z_{0},z_{1})\right\|_{2}^{2}\right]. (9.33)

对于固定路径构建，逐点最优解是条件期望For a fixed path construction, the pointwise optimal solution is the conditional expectation

𝒗ψ⋆​(z,t)=𝔼​[ut​(z0,z1)∣zt=z,t].\bm{v}_{\psi}^{\star}(z,t)=\mathbb{E}\bigl[u_{t}(z_{0},z_{1})\mid z_{t}=z,\,t\bigr]. (9.34)

这只是一个条件均值回归结果，但它使流匹配的作用变得精确：在理想条件下，学习到的向量场对应于连续的传输连接This is simply a conditional-mean regression result, but it makes the role of Flow Matching precise: under ideal conditions, the learned vector field corresponds to a continuous transport connectingq¯ϕ\bar{q}_{\phi}和andp1p_{1}，这又定义了先验, which in turn defines the priorpψ​(z0)p_{\psi}(z_{0}).

因此，必须区分两个目标。第一个，Hence, two objectives must be distinguished. The first,

maxψ⁡𝔼z0∼q¯ϕ​[log⁡pψ​(z0)],\max_{\psi}\;\mathbb{E}_{z_{0}\sim\bar{q}_{\phi}}[\log p_{\psi}(z_{0})], (9.35)

是先前学习的严格概率目标。第二个，is the strict probabilistic objective for prior learning. The second,

minψ⁡ℒFM​(ψ;ϕ),\min_{\psi}\;\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{FM}}(\psi;\phi), (9.36)

是一个实用的求解器，用于学习相同先验的向量场。它们服务于相同的先验建模问题，但它们不是同一个数学对象。特别是，is a practical solver for learning the vector field of the same prior. They serve the same prior-modeling problem, but they are not the same mathematical object. In particular,ℒFM\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{FM}}无法逐项识别cannot be identified term-by-term with−log⁡pψ​(z0)-\log p_{\psi}(z_{0})在埃尔博。in the ELBO.

9.5 培训目标的严格形式Strict Form of the Training Objective

如果解码器可以计算If the decoder can computelog⁡pθ​(x∣z0)\log p_{\theta}(x\mid z_{0})准确地说，那么严格的训练目标就是最大化（exactly, then the strict training objective is to maximize (9.17），或等效地最小化负 ELBO。定义), or equivalently to minimize the negative ELBO. Define

LREC​(x)\displaystyle L_{\mathrm{REC}}(x) :=−𝔼qϕ​(z0∣x)​[log⁡pθ​(x∣z0)],\displaystyle:=-\mathbb{E}_{q_{\phi}(z_{0}\mid x)}\bigl[\log p_{\theta}(x\mid z_{0})\bigr], (9.37)
LPRIOR​(x)\displaystyle L_{\mathrm{PRIOR}}(x) :=−𝔼qϕ​(z0∣x)​[log⁡pψ​(z0)],\displaystyle:=-\mathbb{E}_{q_{\phi}(z_{0}\mid x)}\bigl[\log p_{\psi}(z_{0})\bigr], (9.38)
LREG​(x)\displaystyle L_{\mathrm{REG}}(x) :=𝔼qϕ​(z0∣x)​[log⁡qϕ​(z0∣x)],\displaystyle:=\mathbb{E}_{q_{\phi}(z_{0}\mid x)}\bigl[\log q_{\phi}(z_{0}\mid x)\bigr], (9.39)

使得总的单样本损失变为so that the total single-sample loss becomes

LTotalstrict​(x):=LREC​(x)+LPRIOR​(x)+LREG​(x)=−ℒELBO​(x).L_{\mathrm{Total}}^{\mathrm{strict}}(x):=L_{\mathrm{REC}}(x)+L_{\mathrm{PRIOR}}(x)+L_{\mathrm{REG}}(x)=-\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{ELBO}}(x). (9.40)

对数据分布的期望给出了严格的训练目标Taking expectation over the data distribution gives the strict training objective

minϕ,θ,ψ⁡𝔼pdata​(x)​[LTotalstrict​(x)]⟺maxϕ,θ,ψ⁡𝔼pdata​(x)​[ℒELBO​(x)].\min_{\phi,\theta,\psi}\;\mathbb{E}_{p_{\mathrm{data}}(x)}\bigl[L_{\mathrm{Total}}^{\mathrm{strict}}(x)\bigr]\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad\max_{\phi,\theta,\psi}\;\mathbb{E}_{p_{\mathrm{data}}(x)}\bigl[\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{ELBO}}(x)\bigr]. (9.41)

因此，真正对应于最大化边际似然下限的目标始终是 ELBO；流匹配只是学习先验知识的有效实现。Therefore, the objective that truly corresponds to maximizing a lower bound of the marginal likelihood is always the ELBO; Flow Matching is only an efficient implementation for learning the prior.

10 采样、推理和概率估计详细信息Sampling, Inference, and Probability Estimation Details

本附录补充了抽样、连续、无条件似然估计和条件概率估计的严格表述This appendix supplements the strict formulation of sampling, continuation, unconditional likelihood estimation, and conditional probability estimation in𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM。由于正文仅介绍总体框架，因此我们在此提供详细信息。. Since the main text only presents the overall framework, we provide the details here.

10.1 采样和推理过程Sampling and Inference Procedure

生成新样本To generate a new sample from𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM，应该遵循模型定义的生成过程，而不是训练期间使用的近似后验路径。首先，从简单基础分布中采样潜在种子：, one should follow the generative process defined by the model, rather than the approximate posterior path used during training. First, sample a latent seed from the simple base distribution:

z1∼p1​(z1)=𝒩​(0,I).z_{1}\sim p_{1}(z_{1})=\mathcal{N}(0,I). (10.1)

其次，对向量场进行向后积分以获得潜在样本：Second, integrate the vector field backward to obtain a latent sample:

d​ztd​t=𝒗ψ​(zt,t),t:1→0,\frac{\mathrm{d}z_{t}}{\mathrm{d}t}=\bm{v}_{\psi}(z_{t},t),\qquad t:1\rightarrow 0, (10.2)

以便从so that starting fromz​(1)=z1z(1)=z_{1}产量yieldsz​(0)=z0z(0)=z_{0}。在实践中，可以使用 Euler、Heun 或高阶 ODE 求解器。此步骤生成全局潜在语义而不是标记本身。. In practice, Euler, Heun, or higher-order ODE solvers can be used. This step generates global latent semantics rather than tokens themselves.

第三，解码器生成以潜在条件为条件的文本：Third, the decoder generates text conditioned on the latent:

x∼pθ​(x∣z0).x\sim p_{\theta}(x\mid z_{0}). (10.3)

如果解码器是自回归的，则这一步是条件自回归采样；如果解码器是非自回归或双向的，则它成为相应的条件恢复过程。因此，采样If the decoder is autoregressive, this step is conditional autoregressive sampling; if the decoder is non-autoregressive or bidirectional, it becomes the corresponding conditional recovery procedure. Hence, sampling in𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM本质上是两个阶段：首先对全局潜在样本进行采样，然后实现以其为条件的文本。is inherently two-stage: one first samples a global latent, and then realizes the text conditioned on it.

如果任务提供前缀If a task provides a prefixxprex^{\mathrm{pre}}，推理首先将前缀编码为条件潜在变量：, inference first encodes the prefix into a conditional latent:

zpre∼qϕ​(zpre∣xpre),z^{\mathrm{pre}}\sim q_{\phi}(z^{\mathrm{pre}}\mid x^{\mathrm{pre}}), (10.4)

然后逐块生成响应潜在值。令之前生成的块为and then generates the response latent block by block. Let the previously generated blocks bez^0(<b)\hat{z}_{0}^{(<b)}。的. Thebb-th 响应块是由生成的-th response block is generated by

z^0(b)=Φ0←1ψ​(ϵ(b);zpre,z^0(<b)),ϵ(b)∼𝒩​(0,I).\hat{z}_{0}^{(b)}=\Phi^{\psi}_{0\leftarrow 1}\!\bigl(\epsilon^{(b)};z^{\mathrm{pre}},\hat{z}_{0}^{(<b)}\bigr),\qquad\epsilon^{(b)}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,I). (10.5)

然后响应被解码为The response is then decoded as

x^res∼pθ​(xres∣xpre,zpre,z^0(1:B)).\hat{x}^{\mathrm{res}}\sim p_{\theta}\!\bigl(x^{\mathrm{res}}\mid x^{\mathrm{pre}},z^{\mathrm{pre}},\hat{z}_{0}^{(1:B)}\bigr). (10.6)

这正是正文中描述的前缀编码、分块生成和条件解码过程。This is exactly the prefix-encoding, blockwise-generation, and conditional-decoding procedure described in the main text.

10.2 无条件对数似然和 PPL 估计Unconditional Log-Likelihood and PPL Estimation

对于数据集For a dataset𝒟\mathcal{D}，如果直接使用 ELBO 作为下界, if one directly uses the ELBO as a lower bound onlog⁡p​(x)\log p(x)，可以将基于 ELBO 的困惑度定义为, one may define an ELBO-based perplexity as

PPLELBO:=exp⁡(−∑x∈𝒟ℒELBO​(x)∑x∈𝒟|x|),\mathrm{PPL}_{\mathrm{ELBO}}:=\exp\left(-\frac{\sum_{x\in\mathcal{D}}\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{ELBO}}(x)}{\sum_{x\in\mathcal{D}}|x|}\right), (10.7)

哪里where|x||x|表示序列长度。自从denotes sequence length. SinceℒELBO​(x)≤log⁡p​(x)\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{ELBO}}(x)\leq\log p(x), PPLELBO\mathrm{PPL}_{\mathrm{ELBO}}应被解释为真实困惑度的上限类型估计。should be interpreted as an upper-bound-type estimate of the true perplexity.

如果解码器可以计算If the decoder can computelog⁡pθ​(x∣z0)\log p_{\theta}(x\mid z_{0})，还可以通过重要性抽样或 IWAE 获得更严格的可能性估计。让, one can also obtain tighter likelihood estimates through importance sampling or IWAE. Let

z0(k)∼qϕ​(z0∣x),log⁡w(k)=log⁡pθ​(x∣z0(k))+log⁡pψ​(z0(k))−log⁡qϕ​(z0(k)∣x).z_{0}^{(k)}\sim q_{\phi}(z_{0}\mid x),\qquad\log w^{(k)}=\log p_{\theta}(x\mid z_{0}^{(k)})+\log p_{\psi}(z_{0}^{(k)})-\log q_{\phi}(z_{0}^{(k)}\mid x). (10.8)

那么 ELBO 式和 IWAE 式估计器是Then the ELBO-style and IWAE-style estimators are

log⁡p^ELBO,K​(x)=1K​∑k=1Klog⁡w(k),log⁡p^IWAE,K​(x)=log⁡(1K​∑k=1Kelog⁡w(k)).\log\widehat{p}_{\mathrm{ELBO},K}(x)=\frac{1}{K}\sum_{k=1}^{K}\log w^{(k)},\qquad\log\widehat{p}_{\mathrm{IWAE},K}(x)=\log\!\left(\frac{1}{K}\sum_{k=1}^{K}e^{\log w^{(k)}}\right). (10.9)

IWAE 估计器通常更严格。当使用IWAE进行评分时，对应的困惑度为The IWAE estimator is generally tighter. When IWAE is used for scoring, the corresponding perplexity is

PPLIWAE:=exp⁡(−∑x∈𝒟log⁡p^IWAE,K​(x)∑x∈𝒟|x|).\mathrm{PPL}_{\mathrm{IWAE}}:=\exp\left(-\frac{\sum_{x\in\mathcal{D}}\log\widehat{p}_{\mathrm{IWAE},K}(x)}{\sum_{x\in\mathcal{D}}|x|}\right). (10.10)

如果解码器本身只能提供下界，则评估只能报告基于界限的 PPL，而不是精确的困惑度。If the decoder itself can provide only a lower bound, then evaluation can report only bound-based PPL rather than exact perplexity.

10.3 条件概率估计和块级条件评分Conditional Probability Estimation and Block-Level Conditional Scoring

在连续性、多项选择评估和候选答案排名中，条件概率比无条件分数更重要。将完整样本分解为In continuation, multiple-choice evaluation, and candidate-response ranking, conditional probability is more important than the unconditional score. Let a full sample be decomposed as

x=(xpre,xres),x=(x^{\mathrm{pre}},x^{\mathrm{res}}), (10.11)

哪里wherexprex^{\mathrm{pre}}是给定的前缀并且is the given prefix andxresx^{\mathrm{res}}是要评估的响应。精确的条件对数概率满足is the response to be evaluated. The exact conditional log-probability satisfies

log⁡p​(xres∣xpre)=log⁡p​(xpre,xres)−log⁡p​(xpre).\log p(x^{\mathrm{res}}\mid x^{\mathrm{pre}})=\log p(x^{\mathrm{pre}},x^{\mathrm{res}})-\log p(x^{\mathrm{pre}}). (10.12)

因此，可以将相同的无条件估计器分别应用于联合样本和前缀样本，然后取差值以获得插件条件估计器：Hence one can apply the same unconditional estimator separately to the joint sample and the prefix sample, and then take the difference to obtain a plug-in conditional estimator:

log⁡p^condELBO​(xres∣xpre):=ℒELBO​(xpre,xres)−ℒELBO​(xpre),\widehat{\log p}_{\mathrm{cond}}^{\mathrm{ELBO}}(x^{\mathrm{res}}\mid x^{\mathrm{pre}}):=\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{ELBO}}(x^{\mathrm{pre}},x^{\mathrm{res}})-\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{ELBO}}(x^{\mathrm{pre}}), (10.13)

和and

log⁡p^cond,KIWAE​(xres∣xpre):=log⁡p^IWAE,K​(xpre,xres)−log⁡p^IWAE,K​(xpre).\widehat{\log p}_{\mathrm{cond},K}^{\mathrm{IWAE}}(x^{\mathrm{res}}\mid x^{\mathrm{pre}}):=\log\widehat{p}_{\mathrm{IWAE},K}(x^{\mathrm{pre}},x^{\mathrm{res}})-\log\widehat{p}_{\mathrm{IWAE},K}(x^{\mathrm{pre}}). (10.14)

应该强调的是，两者（It should be emphasized that both (10.13) 和 () and (10.14) 是插件估算器。它们是通过将无条件估计器替换为条件恒等式而获得的，并且它们不会自动从无条件估计器继承下界属性。严格来说，它们因此应该被解释为条件对数似然的实用估计器。) are plug-in estimators. They are obtained by substituting unconditional estimators into the conditional identity, and they do not automatically inherit a lower-bound property from the unconditional estimators. Strictly speaking, they should therefore be interpreted as practical estimators of conditional log-likelihood.

对于块因果先验，条件估计器也可以以与架构一致的块形式编写。假设潜在序列被划分为前缀块和响应块：For a block-causal prior, the conditional estimator can also be written in a blockwise form aligned with the architecture. Suppose the latent sequence is partitioned into prefix blocks and response blocks:

z=(z(1),…,z(B),z(B+1),…,z(B+R)).z=(z^{(1)},\dots,z^{(B)},z^{(B+1)},\dots,z^{(B+R)}). (10.15)

如果先验承认块级因果分解，那么If the prior admits a block-level causal factorization, then

pψ​(z)=pψ​(z(1))​∏b=2B+Rpψ​(z(b)∣z(<b)).p_{\psi}(z)=p_{\psi}(z^{(1)})\prod_{b=2}^{B+R}p_{\psi}(z^{(b)}\mid z^{(<b)}). (10.16)

11 统一马尔可夫路径视图下的比较Comparison Under a Unified Markov Path View

本附录进一步发展了统一文本建模的正文讨论背后的数学比较。核心问题不在于哪种方法在表面上更像扩散，而是：每种方法将文本分布分解到什么状态空间、沿着什么类型的路径，以及该路径在生成中发挥什么作用？This appendix further develops the mathematical comparison behind the main-text discussion of unified text modeling. The central question is not which method is more diffusion-like at a superficial level, but rather: into what state space and along what type of path does each method factorize the text distribution, and what role does that path play in generation?

11.1 基于过程的生成模型的统一框架A Unified Framework for Process-Based Generative Models

要建立通用语言，请考虑基于过程的生成模型的抽象定义。让To establish a common language, consider the abstract definition of a process-based generative model. Let

Y=(Yt)t∈𝒯,Yt∈𝒮,Y=(Y_{t})_{t\in\mathcal{T}},\qquad Y_{t}\in\mathcal{S}, (11.1)

哪里where𝒮\mathcal{S}是状态空间并且is the state space and𝒯\mathcal{T}是离散时间或连续时间。如果存在一系列过渡内核is either discrete time or continuous time. If there exists a family of transition kernels

Kt←s​(d​yt∣ys),s≤t,K_{t\leftarrow s}(\mathrm{d}y_{t}\mid y_{s}),\qquad s\leq t, (11.2)

满足查普曼-柯尔莫哥洛夫关系，则satisfying the Chapman–Kolmogorov relation, thenYY形成马尔可夫过程。如果另外指定一个发射内核forms a Markov process. If one additionally specifies an emission kernel

eθ​(x∣yt⋆),e_{\theta}(x\mid y_{t_{\star}}), (11.3)

那么文本分布可以统一写为then the text distribution can be written uniformly as

pθ​(x)=∫eθ​(x∣yt⋆)​pθ​(d​Y).p_{\theta}(x)=\int e_{\theta}(x\mid y_{t_{\star}})\,p_{\theta}(\mathrm{d}Y). (11.4)

在此框架内，AR、LLaDA、Plaid 和Within this framework, the difference among AR, LLaDA, Plaid, and𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM不仅仅是每个人是否承认逐步采样算法。本质区别在于，它们将不同状态空间上的文本分布分解，并为底层路径分配根本不同的角色。更具体地说，它们至少在以下六个方面有所不同：状态空间、状态轨迹对象、转换机制、路径在生成中的作用、读出观察的点以及训练目标相对于真实对数似然的紧密度。is not simply whether each admits a stepwise sampling algorithm. The essential distinction is that they factorize the text distribution over different state spaces and assign fundamentally different roles to the underlying paths. More specifically, they differ at least in the following six aspects: state space, state trajectory object, transition mechanism, the role of the path in generation, the point at which the observation is read out, and the tightness of the training objective relative to the true log-likelihood.

这种统一的观点表明，关键问题不是哪种方法使用扩散，而是哪种类型的分布复杂性被分解为哪种状态空间上的哪种路径，以及该路径是依赖于观察的腐败路径还是独立于观察的潜在先验路径。This unified view shows that the key question is not which method uses diffusion, but rather what type of distributional complexity is decomposed into what kind of path over what kind of state space, and whether that path is an observation-dependent corruption path or an observation-independent latent prior path.

11.2 与自回归模型的区别：为什么要扩散Difference from Autoregressive Models: Why Diffusion

AR 直接通过链式法则对文本进行建模：AR models text directly via the chain rule:

pηAR​(x)=∏i=1Lpη​(xi∣x<i).p_{\eta}^{\mathrm{AR}}(x)=\prod_{i=1}^{L}p_{\eta}(x_{i}\mid x_{<i}). (11.5)

其负对数似然为Its negative log-likelihood is

−log⁡pηAR​(x)=∑i=1L−log⁡pη​(xi∣x<i).-\log p_{\eta}^{\mathrm{AR}}(x)=\sum_{i=1}^{L}-\log p_{\eta}(x_{i}\mid x_{<i}). (11.6)

因此，AR 的优势是精确的标记级可能性以及最直接的训练和评估协议。它的局限性来自于固定的从左到右的调节顺序。The advantage of AR is therefore exact token-level likelihood and the most direct training and evaluation protocol. Its limitation comes from the fixed left-to-right conditioning order.

统一路径框架下，可以使用前缀状态来编写ARUnder the unified path framework, AR can be written using prefix states

Si:=x1:i,S0:=∅.S_{i}:=x_{1:i},\qquad S_{0}:=\varnothing. (11.7)

然后Then(Si)i=0L(S_{i})_{i=0}^{L}形成时间非齐次马尔可夫链，其一步转移核正是 AR 条件分布：forms a time-inhomogeneous Markov chain, whose one-step transition kernel is exactly the AR conditional distribution:

ℙ​(Si=si∣S0:i−1)=ℙ​(Si=si∣Si−1=si−1)=pη​(xi∣x<i).\mathbb{P}(S_{i}=s_{i}\mid S_{0:i-1})=\mathbb{P}(S_{i}=s_{i}\mid S_{i-1}=s_{i-1})=p_{\eta}(x_{i}\mid x_{<i}). (11.8)

因此，AR 的核心归纳偏差不仅仅是马尔可夫性，而是调节仅限于唯一前缀过滤的事实Thus, the core inductive bias of AR is not merely Markovianity, but the fact that conditioning is restricted to the unique prefix filtration

σ​(X1)⊂σ​(X1:2)⊂⋯⊂σ​(X1:L).\sigma(X_{1})\subset\sigma(X_{1:2})\subset\cdots\subset\sigma(X_{1:L}). (11.9)

相比之下，模型分布By contrast, the model distribution of𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM不是通过固定的代币顺序来定义，而是通过潜在的边缘化来定义：is not defined through a fixed token order, but by latent marginalization:

pCola​DLM​(x)=∫pθ​(x∣z0)​pψ​(z0)​dz0.p^{\mathrm{Cola\ DLM}}(x)=\int p_{\theta}(x\mid z_{0})\,p_{\psi}(z_{0})\,\mathrm{d}z_{0}. (11.10)

如果解码器本身不是从左到右的自回归，则生成的模型分布不依赖于任何预先指定的标记排序。从这个意义上说，非 AR 性质If the decoder itself is not left-to-right autoregressive, the resulting model distribution is not tied to any pre-specified token ordering. In this sense, the non-AR nature of𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM来自两个层面：先验comes from two levels: the priorpψ​(z0)p_{\psi}(z_{0})是通过连续传输而不是按令牌进行链分解来定义的，如果解码器也是非 AR，则生成过程将变成一个两阶段过程，首先采样全局语义潜在变量，然后有条件地实现文本。is defined by continuous transport rather than token-wise chain factorization, and if the decoder is also non-AR, then generation becomes a two-stage procedure of first sampling global semantic latent variables and then realizing text conditionally.

从优化的角度来看，两个系列都最小化From the optimization viewpoint, both families minimize

KL​(pdata​(x)∥pmodel​(x)),\mathrm{KL}\bigl(p_{\mathrm{data}}(x)\,\|\,p_{\mathrm{model}}(x)\bigr), (11.11)

但他们参数化but they parameterizep​(x)p(x)不同。 AR 使用链式法则分解，而differently. AR uses a chain-rule factorization, whereas𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM使用潜在边缘化。因此，严格意义上的uses latent marginalization. Therefore, the strict meaning of为什么扩散why diffusion这里并不是为了避免最大似然，而是为了提高拟合度here is not to avoid maximum likelihood, but to improve the fit ofpψ​(z0)p_{\psi}(z_{0})通过更具表现力的连续先验家族来聚合后验。to the aggregated posterior through a more expressive continuous prior family.

11.3 与离散去噪语言模型的区别：为什么是连续的Difference from Discrete Denoising Language Models: Why Continuous

离散去噪语言模型（例如 LLaDA）直接在令牌空间中运行。典型的训练目标可以写为Discrete denoising language models such as LLaDA operate directly in token space. A typical training objective can be written as

ℒMDM​(θ):=𝔼t∼U​[0,1],x0,xt​[1t​∑i=1L𝟏​[xti=M]​(−log⁡pθ​(x0i∣xt))],\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{MDM}}(\theta):=\mathbb{E}_{t\sim U[0,1],\,x_{0},\,x_{t}}\left[\frac{1}{t}\sum_{i=1}^{L}\mathbf{1}[x_{t}^{i}=M]\bigl(-\log p_{\theta}(x_{0}^{i}\mid x_{t})\bigr)\right], (11.13)

并满足and satisfies

−𝔼pdata​(x0)​log⁡pθ​(x0)≤ℒMDM​(θ).-\mathbb{E}_{p_{\mathrm{data}}(x_{0})}\log p_{\theta}(x_{0})\leq\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{MDM}}(\theta). (11.14)

因此，LLaDA 通过随机掩码比率下的反向恢复来学习令牌空间分布。它的优点是没有显式的编码器，没有潜在的瓶颈；它的局限性在于它始终保持在离散状态空间中。Thus, LLaDA learns a token-space distribution through reverse recovery under random mask ratios. Its advantage is that it has no explicit encoder and no latent bottleneck; its limitation is that it always remains in a discrete state space.

更准确地说，LLaDA 的前向掩蔽过程可以嵌入到连续时间马尔可夫链中。对于单个令牌，令状态空间为More precisely, the forward masking process of LLaDA can be embedded into a continuous-time Markov chain. For a single token, let the state space be𝒱∪{M}\mathcal{V}\cup\{M\}并定义生成器and define the generator

ℙ​(Xτ=M∣X0=a)=1−exp⁡(−∫0τλ​(u)​du).\mathbb{P}(X_{\tau}=M\mid X_{0}=a)=1-\exp\Bigl(-\int_{0}^{\tau}\lambda(u)\,\mathrm{d}u\Bigr). (11.16)

如果右侧被标识为If the right-hand side is identified witht∈[0,1]t\in[0,1]，恢复前向内核，其中每个标记都被概率屏蔽, one recovers the forward kernel in which each token is masked with probabilitytt，如（, as used in (11.13）。因此，LLaDA 可以严格地理解为具有离散状态和吸收到掩模状态的 CTMC 上的反向恢复问题。). Therefore, LLaDA can be understood rigorously as a reverse recovery problem over a CTMC with discrete states and absorption into the mask state.

相比之下，By contrast,𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM型号modelspψ​(z0)p_{\psi}(z_{0})在连续的潜在空间中而不是在令牌空间中进行离散扩散。这种连续配方提供了三个严格的优势。首先，变量的连续时间变化产生显式的对数密度，即（in continuous latent space rather than performing discrete diffusion in token space. This continuous formulation provides three strict advantages. First, continuous-time change-of-variables yields an explicit log-density, namely (9.13）。其次，欧几里得空间中的矢量场回归允许使用流匹配来直接学习先验几何。第三，连续潜在变量自然支持插值、梯度引导和表示编辑。). Second, vector-field regression in Euclidean space allows the use of Flow Matching to learn prior geometry directly. Third, continuous latent variables naturally support interpolation, gradient guidance, and representation editing.

据此，意义Accordingly, the meaning of为什么连续why continuous并不是连续表示本质上优于离散表示。相反，与离散令牌空间损坏模型相比，连续潜在空间允许更直接地描述概率几何和可逆传输。这是否产生实际收益仍然取决于连续结构是否与数据的低维语义组织一致。is not that continuous representations are inherently superior to discrete ones. Rather, compared with a discrete token-space corruption model, continuous latent space permits a more direct description of probability geometry and reversible transport. Whether this yields actual gains still depends on whether the continuous structure aligns with the low-dimensional semantic organization of the data.

理论优势。Theoretical Advantages.相对于AR，如果解码器是非自回归的，那么Relative to AR, if the decoder is non-autoregressive, then𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM不受单个从左到右排序的约束，并且可以在实现文本之前确定潜在空间中的全局语义，这使其在填充、约束满足和全局规划方面具有潜在的更自然的归纳偏差。相对于离散 DLM，is not constrained by a single left-to-right ordering and can determine global semantics in latent space before realizing text, which gives it a potentially more natural inductive bias for infilling, constraint satisfaction, and global planning. Relative to discrete DLMs,𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM具有连续潜在空间的几何结构，因此支持显式对数密度、矢量场回归、插值和潜在编辑。相对于格纹，has the geometric structure of continuous latent space and therefore supports explicit log-densities, vector-field regression, interpolation, and latent editing. Relative to Plaid,𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM显式引入语义压缩，允许模型学习低维全局表示。如果数据确实表现出低维全局语义和高维局部实现的层次结构，那么这种归纳偏差更接近真实机制。最后，平均 ELBO 的信息分解使得将表示、先验和解码器作为单独的组件进行分析变得很自然。explicitly introduces semantic compression, allowing the model to learn a low-dimensional global representation. If the data indeed exhibit a hierarchical structure of low-dimensional global semantics and high-dimensional local realization, this inductive bias is closer to the true mechanism. Finally, the information decomposition of the average ELBO makes it natural to analyze the representation, prior, and decoder as separate components.

理论限制。Theoretical Limitations. 𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM本质上存在变分差距：inherently suffers from a variational gap:

logp(x)−ℒELBO(x)=KL(qϕ(z0∣x)∥p(z0∣x)).\log p(x)-\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{ELBO}}(x)=\mathrm{KL}\bigl(q_{\phi}(z_{0}\mid x)\,\|\,p(z_{0}\mid x)\bigr). (12.19)

The latent bottleneck also introduces the risk of posterior collapse: if the decoder is too strong, the latent dimension is too small, or the regularization is too strong, thenIq​(X;Z0)I_{q}(X;Z_{0})可能会变得太小，编码器可能会停止传输有用的信息。此外，准确评价may become too small and the encoder may stop transmitting useful information. Importantly, the potential advantage of𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM不会自动遵循使用潜在变量和流。它依赖于数据包含有利的低维语义潜在结构的归纳假设。这需要实验来验证。does not follow automatically from using latent variables and flows. It relies on the inductive assumption that the data contain a favorable low-dimensional semantic latent structure. This requires experiments to verify.

13 全局语义结构的存在Existence of Global Semantic Structures

本节的目标是建立一个可证伪的零假设，并在此基础上表明，如果潜在表示仅由纯粹局部和可分离的组件组成，那么随着潜在维度的变化，最佳时间步长移动不应表现出系统漂移。然后，我们将实验观察到的位移漂移与该零假设进行比较，从而获得关于共享结构存在的更可靠的结论。为了避免将严格建立的结论与引入解释用的结构模型混为一谈，我们首先制定一个抽象的原假设。The goal of this section is to establish a falsifiable null hypothesis and, based on it, show that if the latent representation consists only of purely local and separable components, then the optimal timestep shift should not exhibit a systematic drift as the latent dimension varies. We then compare the experimentally observed shift drift against this null hypothesis, thereby obtaining a more robust conclusion regarding the existence of shared structures. To avoid conflating conclusions that can be established rigorously with structural models introduced for interpretation, we first formulate an abstract null hypothesis.

推论13.3Corollary 13.3 （系统漂移反驳了纯粹可分零值）(Systematic drift refutes the purely separable null).

推论结论的边界The boundary of the conclusion in Corollary13.3很明显：它直接排除了潜在空间纯粹局部且可分离的假设。因此，严格可推导的结论是，潜在表示中必须存在某种跨维度共享或联合结构。如果进一步希望将这一结构解释为全局语义因素，则需要额外的建模假设和实验证据。is clear: it directly rules out the hypothesis that the latent space is purely local and separable. Consequently, the strictly derivable conclusion is that some cross-dimensional shared or joint structure must exist in the latent representation. If one further wishes to interpret this structure as a global semantic factor, additional modeling assumptions and experimental evidence are required.

备注13.4Remark 13.4 （具有分辨率依赖性转变的结构同源性）(Structural homology with resolution-dependent shift).

(的意义The significance of (13.13）并不是说它唯一地标识了一个真正的全局变量，而是一旦在多个潜在维度上重复观察到一个共享因子，该机制) is not that it uniquely identifies a true global variable, but rather that once a shared factor is repeatedly observed across multiple latent dimensions, the mechanism

increasing dimension⇒stronger effective SNR⇒logarithmic compensation in the optimal shift\text{increasing dimension}\;\Rightarrow\;\text{stronger effective SNR}\;\Rightarrow\;\text{logarithmic compensation in the optimal shift}

自然产生。这在结构上与稳定扩散中依赖于分辨率的时间步长变化的直觉是一致的。不同之处在于，在当前情况下，共享的是潜在表示内的联合结构，而在图像情况下，共享内容来自更高分辨率下更全局分布的信息。arises naturally. This is structurally homologous to the intuition underlying resolution-dependent timestep shift in Stable Diffusion. The difference is that, in the present case, what is shared is a joint structure within the latent representation, whereas in the image case the shared content comes from more globally distributed information under higher resolution.

需要强调的是，共享因子模型的主要作用是解释系统漂移的形式，而不是取代上述严格的矛盾论证。后者回答了如果观察到漂移，哪些假设必定失败，而前者则解释了这种漂移与哪种结构最一致。It should be emphasized that the main role of the shared-factor model is to explain the form of the systematic drift, rather than to replace the rigorous contradiction argument above. The latter answers which hypotheses must fail if drift is observed, whereas the former explains what kind of structure such drift is most consistent with.

与 VAE logSNR 的关系Relation to VAE logSNR

上述分析还解释了另一个经验现象：即使潜在维度固定，当 VAE 后验的 logSNR 改变时，最佳时间步长移动仍然可能发生变化。原因是 VAE 不是无噪声编码器。在（The above analysis also explains another empirical phenomenon: even when the latent dimension is fixed, the optimal timestep shift may still change when the logSNR of the VAE posterior is altered. The reason is that the VAE is not a noiseless encoder. In (13.6），术语), the termuu精确地代表了后验不确定性。如果时间步长precisely represents posterior uncertainty. If the timesteptt是固定的，则相对于语义变量的总噪声协方差为is fixed, then the total noise covariance with respect to the semantic variable is

Σnoise​(t)=αt2​Σu+σt2​I.\Sigma_{\mathrm{noise}}(t)=\alpha_{t}^{2}\Sigma_{u}+\sigma_{t}^{2}I. (13.14)

当 VAE logSNR 降低时，这通常意味着后验方差增加，即When the VAE logSNR decreases, this typically implies that the posterior variance increases, that is,Σu\Sigma_{u}变得更大。因此，在相同的原始时间步长，有效语义信息保存在潜在的、becomes larger. Consequently, at the same raw timestep, the effective semantic information preserved in the latent,

I​(s;zt)=12​log​det(I+αt2​Σs​(αt2​Σu+σt2​I)−1),I(s;z_{t})=\frac{1}{2}\log\det\!\Bigl(I+\alpha_{t}^{2}\Sigma_{s}(\alpha_{t}^{2}\Sigma_{u}+\sigma_{t}^{2}I)^{-1}\Bigr), (13.15)

整体减少。换句话说，在具有较大后验方差的更平滑的潜在空间中，相同的扩散时间步对应于较低的有效语义SNR。因此，为了使训练和采样保持在类似的最佳语义信息范围内，还必须重新校准时间步转移。decreases overall. In other words, in a smoother latent space with larger posterior variance, the same diffusion timestep corresponds to a lower effective semantic SNR. Therefore, in order for training and sampling to remain within a similar optimal semantic information regime, the timestep shift must also be recalibrated.

这说明，改变潜在维度和改变VAE logSNR表面上是两个不同的操作，但从信息论的角度来看，它们作用于同一个核心对象，即有效互信息曲线This shows that changing the latent dimension and changing the VAE logSNR are, on the surface, two different operations, but they act on the same core object from an information-theoretic perspective, namely the effective mutual information curveI​(s;zt)I(s;z_{t})语义变量沿扩散时间的变化。前者主要改变共享信息跨维度聚合和放大的方式，而后者主要改变每个时间步的有效本底噪声。两者都会导致最佳信息机制沿着原始时间步轴漂移。of the semantic variable along diffusion time. The former mainly changes how shared information is aggregated and amplified across dimensions, whereas the latter mainly changes the effective noise floor at each timestep. Both can cause the optimal information regime to drift along the raw timestep axis.

为什么这进一步指向语义结构Why this further points to semantic structure

推论Corollary13.3单独仅意味着共享或联合结构的存在；它尚未确定该结构必然携带语义信息。为了强化对影响语义的共享结构的结论，需要任务级选择性证据。一个特别信息丰富的情况如下：alone only implies the existence of shared or joint structure; it does not yet establish that this structure necessarily carries semantic information. To strengthen the conclusion to shared structure that affects semantics, one needs task-level selective evidence. A particularly informative situation is the following:

  1. 1.

    重建质量在不同班次中保持相对稳定；reconstruction quality remains relatively stable across different shifts;

  2. 2.

    语义下游指标对这种转变高度敏感；semantic downstream metrics are highly sensitive to the shift;

  3. 3.

    并且最佳偏移表现出随潜在维度的系统漂移。and the optimal shift exhibits systematic drift with the latent dimension.

如果这三个条件同时成立，那么仅仅说这种转变改变了本地代币变现的难度就不再合理了。更合理的解释是，这种转变是调整潜在先验相对于某些共享高级结构的噪声校准，而这种共享结构恰恰涉及语义组织。If these three conditions hold simultaneously, then it is no longer plausible to explain the phenomenon merely by saying that the shift changes the difficulty of local token realization. A more reasonable interpretation is that the shift is adjusting the noise calibration of the latent prior with respect to some shared high-level structure, and that this shared structure is precisely involved in semantic organization.

从信息论的角度来看，这意味着改变移位并不会显着改变解码器恢复局部细节的能力，但会显着改变扩散过程中高级任务所需的共享信息的保存机制。因此，被重新校准的更可能不是局部重建误差，而是更高层次的互信息的语义成分。From an information-theoretic standpoint, this means that changing the shift does not substantially alter the decoder’s ability to recover local details, but does substantially change the preservation regime of the shared information required by high-level tasks during the diffusion process. Therefore, what is being recalibrated is more likely not local reconstruction error, but the semantic component of mutual information at a higher level.

换句话说，如果重构始终保持强大，而语义度量却发生很大变化，那么受影响的主要量不是解码器的本地实现能力，而是潜在先验与高级共享信息的对齐。结合上面的矛盾结果，这产生了一个更强但仍然稳健的结论：潜在空间包含影响语义的共享或联合结构。In other words, if reconstruction remains consistently strong while semantic metrics vary substantially, then the main quantity being affected is not the decoder’s local realization capability, but rather the alignment of the latent prior with high-level shared information. Combined with the contradiction result above, this yields a stronger yet still robust conclusion: the latent space contains shared or joint structures that affect semantics.

备注13.5Remark 13.5 （本节严格支持的结论）(Conclusions that are rigorously supported in this section).

在一大类纯粹局部且可分离的潜在假设下，最佳时间步长移动不应随潜在维度系统性地漂移。实验中观察到的稳定漂移驳斥了这一零假设，因此暗示潜在空间中存在跨维度共享或联合结构。此外，如果这种漂移主要表现在语义度量而不是重构度量中，那么我们可以进一步得出这样的结论：这种共享或联合结构确实参与了高级语义组织。Under a broad class of purely local and separable latent hypotheses, the optimal timestep shift should not drift systematically with the latent dimension. The stable drift observed in experiments refutes this null hypothesis and therefore implies the existence of cross-dimensional shared or joint structures in the latent space. Furthermore, if this drift is manifested primarily in semantic metrics rather than reconstruction metrics, then one can further conclude that such shared or joint structures indeed participate in high-level semantic organization.

这些结论足以支持这项工作的中心假设：如果这种全局或半全局语义共享结构确实存在于潜在空间中，那么在潜在先验水平上校准噪声调度可能比纯粹基于局部建模的方法提供更实质性的优势。These conclusions are sufficient to support the central hypothesis of this work: if such global or semi-global semantic shared structures do exist in the latent space, then calibrating the noise schedule at the level of the latent prior may offer a more substantial advantage than methods based purely on local modeling.

因此，更准确的说法不仅仅是离散模型本质上更简单，而是Therefore, the more accurate statement is not merely that discrete models are inherently simpler, but rather that离散模型中的训练、评估和生成都更直接地作用于同一离散概率对象，而连续潜在模型还通过潜在空间集成、后验先验匹配和解码器发射兼容性来调节。training, evaluation, and generation in discrete models all act more directly on the same discrete probabilistic object, whereas continuous latent models are additionally mediated by latent-space integration, posterior–prior matching, and decoder-emission compatibility.

14.4.3 LLaDA：主要差异出现在离散观测水平而不是潜在校准水平LLaDA: the main discrepancy arises at the discrete observation level rather than the latent calibration level

LLaDA 与 AR 并不相同，但与 AR 相比LLaDA is not identical to AR, but compared with𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM，它的恢复对象仍然是离散的观察状态本身，而不是首先将样本相关的后验编码为连续的潜在状态，然后需要一个独立的条件先验来逐点匹配它。因此，尽管LLaDA也可能表现出代理间隙，但其主要差异仍然集中在离散令牌空间内，而不是在后验-先验密度碰撞特征中。, its recovery object is still the discrete observed state itself, rather than first encoding the sample-dependent posterior into a continuous latent and then requiring an independent conditional prior to match it pointwise. Therefore, even though LLaDA may also exhibit a surrogate gap, its main discrepancy is still concentrated within the discrete token space, rather than in the posterior–prior density collision characteristic of𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM。因此，LLaDA 中 PPL 和生成之间的相关性通常仍然比连续潜在模型中更强。. For this reason, the correlation between PPL and generation is usually still stronger in LLaDA than in continuous latent models.

15 噪声表、logSNR 和流量匹配的统一理论视图A Unified Theoretical View of Noise Schedule, logSNR, and Flow Matching

本节将前面对噪声调度、流匹配、潜在维度相关的移位漂移和语义信息校准的讨论整合到一个理论链中。关键问题不是为什么特定的经验超参数有效，而是：This section consolidates the preceding discussion of noise schedule, Flow Matching, latent-dimension-dependent shift drift, and semantic information calibration into a single theoretical chain. The key question is not why a particular empirical hyperparameter works, but rather:噪声表控制什么数学对象what mathematical object the noise schedule controls in𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM，以及该对象如何进入训练目标并最终影响语义建模质量, and how this object enters the training objective and ultimately affects semantic modeling quality。更具体地说，我们确立了以下四点：. More specifically, we establish the following four points:

  1. 1.

    噪声表和 logSNR 曲线是同一前向噪声过程的两个等效参数化；the noise schedule and the logSNR curve are two equivalent parameterizations of the same forward noising process;

  2. 2.

    在流匹配中，logSNR对损失的影响既通过期望内采样测量的变化也通过监督目标速度场的尺度变化而产生；in Flow Matching, the effect of logSNR on the loss arises both through the change of sampling measure inside the expectation and through the scale change of the supervised target velocity field;

  3. 3.

    统一时间步长训练通常不等同于统一logSNR训练；uniform-timestep training is generally not equivalent to uniform-logSNR training;

  4. 4.

    最佳时间步长偏移的基本作用不是翻译抽象的时间标签，而是重新校准训练和采样以达到更合适的时间步长。the essential role of the optimal timestep shift is not to translate an abstract time label, but to recalibrate training and sampling toward a more appropriate有效的语义信息机制effective semantic information regime.

15.1 噪声表和 logSNR 作为等效参数化Noise Schedule and logSNR as Equivalent Parameterizations

我们从正文和附录中使用的标准转发过程开始：We begin with the standard forward process used throughout the main text and appendix:

这清楚地表明，对 DiT 来说重要的不是原始时间步本身，而是在该时间步的潜在中保留了多少有效语义信息。从这个意义上说，This makes clear that what matters to the DiT is not the raw timestep itself, but how much effective semantic information remains in the latent at that timestep. In this sense,

15.5 为什么潜在维度和 VAE logSNR 会改变最优值Why Latent Dimension and VAE logSNR Shift the Optimum

上述观点与命题一致The viewpoint developed above is consistent with Proposition13.2和推论and Corollary13.3。如果潜在表示在维度上是纯粹局部的、可分离的和同质的，那么最佳移位将不会随维度系统性地漂移。当凭经验观察到稳定漂移时，自然的解释是潜在维度和 VAE 后验 logSNR 都修改了方程中的有效语义信息曲线（. If the latent representation were purely local, separable, and homogeneous across dimensions, then the optimal shift would not systematically drift with dimension. When a stable drift is observed empirically, the natural interpretation is that latent dimension and VAE posterior logSNR both modify the effective semantic-information curve in Equation (15.32).

潜在维度。Latent dimension.

共享因子模型下Under the shared-factor model

zi=Ai​g+ξi,i=1,…,d,z_{i}=A_{i}g+\xi_{i},\qquad i=1,\dots,d, (15.35)

如果不同的潜在维度重复观察相同的低维共享因子if different latent dimensions repeatedly observe the same low-dimensional shared factorgg，那么标准线性高斯推理意味着有效恢复信噪比按比例缩放, then standard linear-Gaussian inference implies that the effective recovery signal-to-noise ratio scales as

SNReff​(d)∝d.\mathrm{SNR}_{\mathrm{eff}}(d)\propto d. (15.36)

因此，关于共享因子的可恢复信息满足近似Consequently, the recoverable information about the shared factor satisfies the approximation

I​(g;zt)≈r2​log⁡(1+c⋅d⋅SNReff​(t)).I(g;z_{t})\approx\frac{r}{2}\log\!\Bigl(1+c\cdot d\cdot\mathrm{SNR}_{\mathrm{eff}}(t)\Bigr). (15.37)

这意味着增加潜在维度可以增强有关共享语义结构的可恢复信息。为了保持在可比较的语义恢复机制中进行训练，时间步长偏移必须补偿这种维度效应，这自然会导致形式的对数定律This means that increasing the latent dimension can strengthen the recoverable information about shared semantic structure. In order to keep training in a comparable semantic-recovery regime, the timestep shift must compensate for this dimensional effect, which naturally leads to a logarithmic law of the form

δ⋆​(d)=a​log⁡d+b.\delta^{\star}(d)=a\log d+b. (15.38)
VAE 后验 logSNR。VAE posterior logSNR.

另一方面，降低 VAE 的后验 logSNR 通常对应于增加后验方差，即放大On the other hand, lowering the posterior logSNR of the VAE typically corresponds to increasing posterior variance, that is, enlargingΣu\Sigma_{u}。通过方程 (. By Equation (15.32），对于固定的), for fixedtt，增加, increasing

αt2​Σu+σt2​I\alpha_{t}^{2}\Sigma_{u}+\sigma_{t}^{2}I

减少了有效的语义互信息。因此，相同的原始时间步对应于具有较大后验方差的更平滑的潜在空间中较低的有效语义SNR。为了使训练和采样与可比较的语义信息机制保持一致，最佳转变必须相应改变。reduces the effective semantic mutual information. Therefore, the same raw timestep corresponds to a lower effective semantic SNR in a smoother latent space with larger posterior variance. To align training and sampling with a comparable semantic-information regime, the optimal shift must change accordingly.

这表明改变潜在维度和改变VAE后验logSNR表面上是两个不同的操作，但从信息论的角度来看它们作用于同一个核心对象：有效语义信息曲线This shows that changing the latent dimension and changing the VAE posterior logSNR are, on the surface, two different operations, but from an information-theoretic perspective they act on the same core object: the effective semantic-information curveI​(s;zt)I(s;z_{t})沿着扩散时间。前者主要改变共享信息跨维度聚合和放大的方式，而后者主要改变每个时间步的有效本底噪声。along diffusion time. The former mainly changes how shared information is aggregated and amplified across dimensions, whereas the latter mainly changes the effective noise floor at each timestep.

备注15.3Remark 15.3 （块大小的作用）(Role of block size).

与潜在维度和后验 logSNR 相比，块大小的影响尚未用封闭形式的定律来表征，例如方程（Compared with latent dimension and posterior logSNR, the effect of block size is not yet characterized by a closed-form law such as Equation (15.38）。然而，块大小改变了块内语义聚合的粒度、跨块条件依赖的强度以及相同噪声范围内的内在建模难度。因此，它通过有效语义信息曲线的形状与时间表间接交互。更准确的说法不是区块大小直接决定调度，而是区块大小和调度通过区块因果先验的有效几何耦合。). Nevertheless, block size changes the granularity of within-block semantic aggregation, the strength of cross-block conditional dependence, and the intrinsic modeling difficulty within the same noise regime. It therefore interacts with the schedule indirectly through the shape of the effective semantic-information curve. The more precise statement is not that block size directly determines the schedule, but that block size and schedule are coupled through the effective geometry of the block-causal prior.

备注15.4Remark 15.4 （总结）(Summary).

In 𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM，噪声表不是训练目标外部的经验超参数。它首先通过定义前向噪声几何, the noise schedule is not an empirical hyperparameter external to the training objective. It first defines the forward noising geometry through(αt,σt)(\alpha_{t},\sigma_{t})，或等效地通过 logSNR 曲线；然后通过采样测量和监督目标速度场的时间尺度共同进入流匹配目标；并且，在语义层面，它校准的不是原始时间步本身，而是高级潜在语义的有效互信息机制。因此，潜在维度、后验不确定性和潜在几何形状的变化都可以通过改变相同的有效语义信息曲线来引起最佳时间步转移的系统漂移。, or equivalently through the logSNR curve; it then enters the Flow Matching objective jointly through the sampling measure and the time-scale of the supervised target velocity field; and, at the semantic level, it calibrates not the raw timestep itself but the effective mutual-information regime of high-level latent semantics. Consequently, changes in latent dimension, posterior uncertainty, and latent geometry can all induce systematic drift in the optimal timestep shift by altering the same effective semantic-information curve.

16 实验详情Experiments Details

16.1 数据集介绍Dataset Introduction

兰巴达。LAMBADA.

兰巴达LAMBADA[74]是一个长上下文单词预测基准，旨在评估模型是否可以使用广泛的话语上下文来进行文本延续。目标词通常很难仅从本地上下文推断出来，而是需要理解分布在前面段落中的信息。在我们的实验中，LAMBADA 被用作代表性的延续式基准来评估全局语义建模和远程上下文连贯性。is a long-context word prediction benchmark designed to evaluate whether a model can use broad discourse context for text continuation. The target word is usually difficult to infer from local context alone and instead requires understanding information distributed across the preceding passage. In our experiments, LAMBADA is used as a representative continuation-style benchmark to evaluate global semantic modeling and long-range contextual coherence.

MMLU。MMLU.

MMLU [33]是一个多任务多项选择基准，涵盖广泛的学科，包括人文、社会科学、STEM 和专业领域。它被广泛用于评估广泛的事实知识和推理能力。在我们的实验中，MMLU 作为具有代表性的知识密集型基准，用于评估多项选择设置下生成答案的质量。is a multitask multiple-choice benchmark covering a wide range of subjects, including humanities, social sciences, STEM, and professional domains. It is widely used to assess broad factual knowledge and reasoning ability. In our experiments, MMLU serves as a representative knowledge-intensive benchmark for evaluating the quality of generated answers under multiple-choice settings.

SIQA。SIQA.

质量保证体系SIQA[82]（社交 IQa）是一项多项选择常识推理基准，重点关注社交情境、意图和反应。每个示例都需要在简短的社交背景下选择最合理的答案。我们使用 SIQA 来评估模型是否能够捕获基于社会的语义并执行连贯的常识推理。(Social IQa) is a multiple-choice commonsense reasoning benchmark focused on social situations, intentions, and reactions. Each example requires selecting the most plausible answer given a short social context. We use SIQA to evaluate whether the model can capture socially grounded semantics and perform coherent commonsense inference.

小队。SQuAD.

小队SQuAD[78]是一个阅读理解基准，其中模型根据给定的段落回答问题。在我们的评估中，它在生成环境中使用，以评估模型是否可以根据上下文证据产生准确的答案。该基准测试通过测试开放式文本生成能力来补充多项选择任务。is a reading comprehension benchmark in which the model answers questions based on a given passage. In our evaluation, it is used in a generative setting to assess whether the model can produce accurate answers conditioned on contextual evidence. This benchmark complements multiple-choice tasks by testing open-form text generation ability.

故事完形填空。Story Cloze.

故事完形填空Story Cloze[68]是一个故事理解基准，要求模型为四句故事上下文选择最合理的结局。它主要评估叙事连贯性、因果推理和常识性理解。我们将其作为话语级语义一致性的基准。is a story understanding benchmark that asks the model to choose the most plausible ending for a four-sentence story context. It mainly evaluates narrative coherence, causal reasoning, and commonsense understanding. We include it as a benchmark for discourse-level semantic consistency.

OBQA。OBQA.

OBQA [64](OpenBookQA) 是一个多项选择题回答基准，旨在测试核心科学事实与更广泛的常识知识的结合。许多问题需要超越直接事实回忆的多跳推理。在我们的实验中，它用于评估受限答案空间下的知识整合和推理。(OpenBookQA) is a multiple-choice question answering benchmark designed to test the combination of core science facts with broader commonsense knowledge. Many questions require multi-hop reasoning beyond direct fact recall. In our experiments, it is used to assess knowledge integration and reasoning under a constrained answer space.

比赛。RACE.

种族RACE[48]是从初高中生英语考试中收集的大规模多项选择阅读理解基准。这些问题通常需要段落理解、推理和推理，而不是简单的跨度提取。我们使用 RACE 来评估更具挑战性的阅读理解和答案选择能力。is a large-scale multiple-choice reading comprehension benchmark collected from English examinations for middle and high school students. The questions often require passage understanding, inference, and reasoning rather than simple span extraction. We use RACE to evaluate more challenging reading comprehension and answer selection ability.

海拉斯瓦格。HellaSwag.

海拉斯瓦格HellaSwag[107]是基于常识推理和句子延续的多项选择基准。任务是在几个对抗性构建的候选者中选择最合理的延续。它被广泛认为是对常识和语义合理性的强有力的测试，包含在这里是为了评估模型区分连贯延续和干扰的能力。is a multiple-choice benchmark for grounded commonsense reasoning and sentence continuation. The task is to select the most plausible continuation among several adversarially constructed candidates. It is widely regarded as a strong test of commonsense and semantic plausibility, and is included here to evaluate the model’s ability to distinguish coherent continuations from distractors.

本作品中的用法。Usage in This Work.

用于章节中的内部组件分析For the internal component analysis in Sections4.2, 4.3, 和, and4.4，我们对从 LAMBADA、MMLU 和 SIQA 测试集中随机采样的子集进行实验，以提高效率和受控比较。对于更广泛的外部比较部分, we conduct experiments on randomly sampled subsets from the test sets of LAMBADA, MMLU, and SIQA for efficiency and controlled comparison. For the broader external comparison in Section4.5，我们还对 SQuAD、Story Cloze、OBQA、RACE 和 HellaSwag 的测试集进行了评估，以在延续、阅读理解、知识密集型推理和常识推理任务方面提供更全面的评估。, we additionally evaluate on the test sets of SQuAD, Story Cloze, OBQA, RACE, and HellaSwag to provide a more comprehensive assessment across continuation, reading comprehension, knowledge-intensive reasoning, and commonsense reasoning tasks.

16.2 基线详细信息Baseline Details

用于章节中的内部组件分析For the internal component analysis in Sections4.2, 4.3, 和, and4.4，比较是在不同配置之间进行的, the comparisons are conducted among different configurations of𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola 分布式LMDLM本身，因此这些部分中没有引入外部基线。外部基线主要用于Sectionitself, so no external baseline is introduced in these sections. External baselines are mainly used in Section4.5用于缩放比较。for scaling comparisons.

自回归基线。Autoregressive Baseline.

我们使用标准自回归语言模型作为主要参考基线。模型基于官方LLaMA框架实现We use a standard autoregressive language model as the primary reference baseline. 提示格式摘要。Summary of prompt formats.

表Table7总结了每个基准测试使用的提示格式。summarizes the prompt format used for each benchmark.

MMLU。MMLU.

MMLU 被评估为 4 路多项选择生成任务。提示包含两个上下文示例，后面是测试问题及其四个候选选项。该模型需要生成正确选项的文本。MMLU is evaluated as a 4-way multiple-choice generation task. The prompt contains two in-context examples, followed by the test question and its four candidate options. The model is required to generate the text of the correct option.

RACE.

RACE is also evaluated as a 4-way multiple-choice generation task. Here, the dataset field already contains the article together with the question, so the full input is placed after Article: and the candidate options are listed below it.

Story Cloze.

Story Cloze is formatted as a story-completion benchmark with two candidate endings. To better match the semantics of narrative continuation, the prompt uses End: instead of Answer: as the completion anchor.

LAMBADA.

LAMBADA is treated as open-ended continuation rather than multiple choice. Since the task is essentially final-word prediction given a long context, we do not use in-context demonstrations. The model directly continues the provided passage prefix, and the first generated word is taken as the prediction.

OBQA.

OBQA is evaluated with the same 2-shot generative multiple-choice protocol as MMLU. The model is required to generate the text of the correct answer option rather than its label.

HellaSwag.

HellaSwag is evaluated as a 4-way situational continuation task. We use Context: as the input field name to emphasize that the model must choose the most plausible continuation for the given context.

SIQA.

SIQA is a 3-way social commonsense multiple-choice benchmark. The template is identical in spirit to the other multiple-choice prompts, except that only three options are presented.

SQuAD.

SQuAD is evaluated as short-answer generation under a standard extractive QA format. The prompt provides a context paragraph and a question, and the model is asked to generate the answer phrase directly. In our unified protocol, the generated answer is normalized before exact-match evaluation.

Final remarks.

These templates are kept identical across AR, LLaDA, and 𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola DLM, so that the comparison focuses on the model family itself rather than on prompt engineering differences. In all cases, evaluation is performed after unified post-processing, including truncation at the first newline and text normalization before matching against the candidate options or reference answers.

16.4 Setup Details

To ensure a fair comparison, we align AR, LLaDA, and 𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola DLM on the same pretraining corpus, tokenizer family, sequence length, batch size, optimizer, learning-rate schedule, hardware setup, and evaluation protocol. As a result, all methods observe the same number of training tokens at matched optimization steps, making step-wise comparison directly meaningful. We also keep the core generation backbone at a comparable scale: AR and LLaDA use ∼\sim1.8B non-embedding transformer parameters, while the DiT backbone in 𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola DLM is also kept at ∼\sim1.8B; the remaining parameter difference comes from the additional VAE required by the continuous latent formulation.

In addition to the matched data, optimization, and model-scale settings in Tables 8 and 9, we further verified implementation-level numerical consistency across the three methods. As shown in Table 10, all models save and load checkpoints in fp32, keep runtime weights in fp32, and perform the main forward computation under bfloat16 autocast, while numerically sensitive operations such as normalization and softmax remain in fp32. Therefore, the precision regime is broadly aligned across methods. The main implementation difference is that 𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola DLM contains an additional VAE encode/decode path, which is intrinsic to continuous latent modeling rather than an extra numerical advantage.

Overall, the comparison is controlled along the main axes that determine pretraining scale and optimization difficulty, including data, tokenizer family, token budget, optimizer, learning-rate schedule, hardware, and evaluation protocol. Therefore, the observed differences mainly reflect the modeling paradigm itself rather than mismatched training resources or evaluation settings.

16.5 Why VAE Pretraining Does Not Compromise Fairness

A potential concern is that Cola DLM includes an additional VAE pretraining stage, whereas the AR baseline is trained fully from scratch. We therefore clarify why this does not undermine the fairness of the comparison.

First, the pretrained VAE encoder is not itself the generative prior of Cola DLM. In our formulation, the generative model is defined by a decoder pθ​(x∣z0)p_{\theta}(x\mid z_{0}) and a latent prior pψ​(z0)p_{\psi}(z_{0}), while qϕ​(z0∣x)q_{\phi}(z_{0}\mid x) is used only for variational inference and latent construction during training. At inference time, new response content is generated by the DiT prior block by block and then decoded into text. Therefore, the extra VAE stage should be understood as learning a stable text–latent interface, rather than pretraining an additional text generator.

Second, the overall comparison is already controlled along the main axes that determine pretraining scale and optimization difficulty. AR, LLaDA, and Cola DLM are aligned on the same training corpus, tokenizer family, sequence length, batch size, optimizer, learning-rate schedule, hardware setup, and evaluation protocol. We also keep the core generation backbone in a comparable regime: AR and LLaDA use ∼\sim1.8B non-embedding transformer parameters, while Cola DLM uses a ∼\sim1.8B DiT prior; the remaining parameter difference comes from the additional VAE required by the continuous latent formulation. As a result, the comparison remains centered on the actual generation backbone rather than on mismatched training resources.

Third, Figure 15 provides an empirical perspective on representation-space stabilization. In the AR model, both the contextual hidden states and the global input embeddings show relatively large drift at the beginning of training, but quickly enter a stable regime. The inter-step drift becomes small after the early phase, and the distance to the first checkpoint also gradually saturates. The pretrained VAE encoder exhibits an even more explicit stabilization pattern: its inter-step drift drops rapidly and then remains nearly flat, while its distance to the early checkpoint changes very little after the initial stage. This indicates that, in both model families, the representation space becomes largely stable relatively early; once this happens, the dominant learning burden is no longer representation construction itself, but the modeling of generation dynamics on top of that space.

This observation is important for interpreting fairness. AR models also spend a nontrivial portion of training on forming and stabilizing their embedding and hidden-state geometry. Cola DLM makes this step explicit through VAE pretraining, but this does not mean that it receives a hidden pretrained generative advantage. Instead, it moves representation stabilization into a separate and modular stage, after which the main text-modeling burden still lies in the DiT prior and the conditional decoder. In this sense, VAE pretraining mainly amortizes representation learning, rather than replacing the need to learn the actual generative mechanism.

Moreover, the results in Figure 3 already suggest that a pretrained encoder alone cannot explain the final gains. Although Fix VAE can be competitive at smaller compute budgets, it saturates earlier, whereas Joint DiT x1 shows the strongest overall scaling trend. If the advantage mainly came from having a pretrained encoder by itself, the fixed-space variant should have remained dominant. Instead, the empirical pattern indicates that the key factor is the subsequent prior learning and co-adaptation with DiT, rather than a frozen pretrained representation alone.

Overall, we view the additional VAE stage as a method-specific representation-construction cost required by continuous latent modeling, analogous in spirit to the early embedding-space formation that AR models must also undergo during training. Once the representation space has stabilized, the comparison remains focused on the generative backbone under matched data, optimization, and evaluation settings. Therefore, the observed performance differences are more appropriately attributed to the modeling paradigm itself, rather than to an advantage from VAE pretraining.

16.6 Fixed vs. Evolving Latent Space Additional Results

As shown in Figure 16, we further compare continuous joint evolution and interval training under a stronger setting where the Interval variant is also initialized from a pretrained VAE. This setting should therefore be interpreted as isolating the effect of continuous versus intermittent latent updates after stable initialization, rather than the effect of initialization quality itself. Even under this stronger setup, Joint DiT x1 remains consistently better than Interval across Task Average, LAMBADA, MMLU, and SIQA. This suggests that the advantage of continuous latent evolution does not merely come from a better starting point. Instead, once a meaningful latent space has been established, the latent representation still benefits more from sustained co-evolution with DiT, while periodic freezing tends to interrupt the mutual adaptation between the evolving latent space and the DiT prior. And this results also further verify the last condition in Eq. (3.35) of Section 3.3.2, and provides strong support for the potential advantage of 𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola DLM.

16.7 VAE LogSNR Formula

For the VAE encoder posterior

qϕ​(z∣x)=𝒩​(μϕ​(x),diag​(σϕ2​(x))),q_{\phi}(z\mid x)=\mathcal{N}\!\left(\mu_{\phi}(x),\mathrm{diag}\!\left(\sigma_{\phi}^{2}(x)\right)\right), (16.1)

we define the VAE logSNR as the log ratio between the signal power carried by the posterior mean and the noise power carried by the posterior variance:

logSNRvae=log⁡𝔼x,i​[μϕ,i​(x)2]𝔼x,i​[σϕ,i​(x)2],\mathrm{logSNR}_{\mathrm{vae}}=\log\frac{\mathbb{E}_{x,i}\!\left[\mu_{\phi,i}(x)^{2}\right]}{\mathbb{E}_{x,i}\!\left[\sigma_{\phi,i}(x)^{2}\right]}, (16.2)

where ii indexes all latent coordinates, including token/spatial positions and channels, and the expectation is taken over the data distribution and latent dimensions.

In practice, we estimate it empirically on a dataset or a mini-batch:

logSNR^vae=log⁡1N​∑n=1N1D​∑i=1Dμn,i21N​∑n=1N1D​∑i=1Dσn,i2,\widehat{\mathrm{logSNR}}_{\mathrm{vae}}=\log\frac{\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}\frac{1}{D}\sum_{i=1}^{D}\mu_{n,i}^{2}}{\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}\frac{1}{D}\sum_{i=1}^{D}\sigma_{n,i}^{2}}, (16.3)

where NN is the number of samples and DD is the number of latent coordinates per sample. If the encoder predicts log-variance, we compute

σn,i2=exp⁡(log⁡σn,i2).\sigma_{n,i}^{2}=\exp\!\left(\log\sigma_{n,i}^{2}\right). (16.4)

A larger VAE logSNR indicates that the posterior mean dominates the posterior uncertainty, corresponding to a cleaner and more deterministic latent representation. Throughout the paper, when we refer to VAE logSNR, we specifically mean the quantity defined in Eq. (16.2).

16.8 Noise Schedule Timestep Shift Visualization

As shown in Figure 17, we visualize the timestep-sampling distributions induced by different timestep-shift settings. Compared with the uniform schedule, LogitNormal schedules place non-uniform emphasis on different parts of the denoising trajectory: increasing μ\mu shifts the distribution toward later timesteps, while σ\sigma controls how concentrated or dispersed the sampling mass is. From the perspective of the main text, this means that timestep shift effectively changes which semantic-information regime is more frequently emphasized during training, rather than simply tuning an isolated numerical hyperparameter.

16.9 Timestep Shift Formula

We implement timestep shift by replacing uniform timestep sampling with a LogitNormal distribution on the normalized timestep. Specifically, let

u∼𝒩​(μ,σ2),u\sim\mathcal{N}(\mu,\sigma^{2}), (16.5)

and map it to the unit interval by the logistic function:

s=sigmoid​(u)=11+e−u,s∈(0,1).s=\mathrm{sigmoid}(u)=\frac{1}{1+e^{-u}},\qquad s\in(0,1). (16.6)

The continuous timestep is then defined as

t=T⋅s=T⋅sigmoid​(u),t=T\cdot s=T\cdot\mathrm{sigmoid}(u), (16.7)

where TT is the maximum diffusion timestep. In practice, a discrete training timestep is obtained by rounding or flooring tt to the valid timestep grid.

Equivalently, the normalized timestep s=t/Ts=t/T follows a LogitNormal distribution:

s∼LogitNormal​(μ,σ2).s\sim\mathrm{LogitNormal}(\mu,\sigma^{2}). (16.8)

Its probability density function is

p​(s;μ,σ)=1σ​2​π​1s​(1−s)​exp⁡(−(log⁡s1−s−μ)22​σ2),s∈(0,1).p(s;\mu,\sigma)=\frac{1}{\sigma\sqrt{2\pi}}\frac{1}{s(1-s)}\exp\!\left(-\frac{(\log\frac{s}{1-s}-\mu)^{2}}{2\sigma^{2}}\right),\qquad s\in(0,1). (16.9)

After rescaling to the timestep domain t∈(0,T)t\in(0,T), the corresponding density becomes

p​(t;μ,σ)=1T​p​(tT;μ,σ).p(t;\mu,\sigma)=\frac{1}{T}\,p\!\left(\frac{t}{T};\mu,\sigma\right). (16.10)

Under this parameterization, μ\mu mainly controls the location of the sampling mass: a larger μ\mu shifts probability toward later timesteps. In contrast, σ\sigma controls the spread of the distribution: a smaller σ\sigma produces a sharper concentration, while a larger σ\sigma yields a more dispersed schedule. Therefore, timestep shift directly changes the distribution of sampled logSNR regimes during training, rather than merely reweighting timestep indices numerically.

17 Discussion

17.1 Understanding the Conditioning Strategies in the First Generation Block

This subsection explains the conditioning strategies compared in Table 5, and further analyzes them from the perspective of conditional Flow Matching in 𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola DLM. The key issue arises in the first generation block, where the model simultaneously sees a known prompt region and an unknown region to be generated. In other words, the input to this block is mixed: part of it should be preserved as condition, while the rest should be completed by the model. The methods in Table 5 differ precisely in how they handle this mixed denoising process.

What makes the first block special.

Later generation blocks are purely generative: all latents in the block are unknown and are produced by denoising. The first generation block is different because it sits immediately after the prefix prompt. As a result, some positions in this block are already determined by the prompt, while the remaining positions are not. A good conditioning strategy should therefore achieve two goals at the same time: it should preserve the known region reliably, and it should allow the unknown region to grow coherently from that preserved context.

From the viewpoint of 𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola DLM, this distinction is especially important because the prior is learned block by block through a conditional flow:

pψ​(z0)=pψ​(z0(1))​∏b=2Bpψ​(z0(b)∣z0(<b)),p_{\psi}(z_{0})=p_{\psi}(z_{0}^{(1)})\prod_{b=2}^{B}p_{\psi}(z_{0}^{(b)}\mid z_{0}^{(<b)}),

and the corresponding conditional Flow Matching objective learns a vector field of the form

vψ​(zt(b),t;z0(<b)).v_{\psi}(z_{t}^{(b)},t;z_{0}^{(<b)}).

That is, the current noisy block is predicted under clean historical latent conditions. At inference time, generation follows the same factorization by transporting a noise seed under the clean prefix and historical latent conditions. Therefore, the mathematically natural role of the known region in the first generation block is not that of a denoising target, but that of a fixed condition.

A decomposition of the first generation block.

To make this point more explicit, let the first generation block be decomposed as

z(1)=(zK,zU),z^{(1)}=(z_{K},z_{U}),

where zKz_{K} denotes the known region determined by the prefix, and zUz_{U} denotes the unknown region to be generated. In an ideal formulation, the task of the first generation block should be understood as

generate ​zU​ under the fixed condition ​(zpre,zK),\text{generate }z_{U}\text{ under the fixed condition }(z_{\mathrm{pre}},z_{K}),

rather than to jointly re-estimate both zKz_{K} and zUz_{U}. Equivalently, the desired conditional prior is closer to

pψ​(zU∣zpre,zK),p_{\psi}(z_{U}\mid z_{\mathrm{pre}},z_{K}),

where the known part serves as a stable boundary condition and only the unknown part is transported by the flow.

Partial repaint.

The first family of methods in Table 5 is partial repaint. These methods repeatedly revisit the early denoising steps and re-inject guidance into the known region during only part of the trajectory.

The parameter tt controls how many repaint cycles are used inside each early denoising step. For example, t=1t=1 means that each step is executed once, while t=3t=3 means that the model denoises, re-noises, and denoises again multiple times before moving on. The parameter mm controls how long the known region remains guided. When m=1.0m=1.0, guidance is applied throughout the whole denoising trajectory of the first block. When m=0.7m=0.7 or m=0.3m=0.3, the model only receives such guidance in the earlier portion of the trajectory, and then the remainder is left to evolve more freely.

The important point is that partial repaint does not keep the known region perfectly fixed. Instead, it replaces the known region with a timestep-matched noisy surrogate during part of the trajectory and only nudges that region back toward the target at selected denoising steps. This makes the strategy softer and more flexible, but also fundamentally weaker as a conditioning mechanism.

A simple example for partial repaint.

Consider a first generation block with four denoising transitions. If we use partial repaint with t=3t=3 and m=0.5m=0.5, then only the first half of the trajectory receives explicit guidance on the known region, while each of these early steps is revisited three times. Intuitively, the model repeatedly tries to correct the early transition, but once it enters the later half of the trajectory, the known region is no longer explicitly reinforced. The final result therefore depends on whether those earlier corrections are strong enough to keep the conditional structure stable.

Clean condition repaint.

The method labeled Clean cond. in Table 5 takes a much stronger approach. Instead of providing only partial or noisy guidance, it keeps the known region directly aligned with the clean condition throughout the denoising process of the first block. In effect, the model always sees an exact and stable version of the prompt-conditioned part, while only the unknown region is allowed to change.

This strategy is much more conservative than partial repaint. It reduces ambiguity in the mixed region and makes the role of the first block very clear: preserve the prompt-conditioned part exactly, and generate the remaining part around it. This is especially useful when the boundary between known and unknown positions is semantically important.

A simple example for clean conditioning.

Suppose the first few positions in the block correspond to prompt content and the remaining positions must be generated. Under clean condition repaint, the prompt side is always kept fixed, no matter how many denoising steps are taken. The model therefore never needs to re-discover or re-estimate that part. Its effort is focused entirely on making the unknown side compatible with a stable context. This is a much easier problem than simultaneously preserving the known side and generating the unknown side under drifting noise.

Left padding and right padding.

The last two methods, Left pad. and Right pad., should be understood as layout-based alternatives rather than repaint-based conditioning strategies. They change where the known condition is placed relative to the region to be generated, but they do not explicitly enforce the condition during denoising in the same way as repaint-based methods do.

Their role in the table is useful for interpretation. If padding alone were sufficient, then a simple positional arrangement would already match the performance of explicit conditioning. If not, then the gain must come from the conditioning mechanism itself rather than from layout alone.

A Flow Matching view of why clean conditioning works best.

The advantage of clean condition repaint is not merely that it provides “stronger guidance.” More fundamentally, it is the only strategy among those compared that preserves the original conditional semantics of 𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola DLM.

Under the standard Flow Matching formulation, let the target conditional velocity be denoted by utu_{t}, and let the optimal vector field be the conditional expectation

v∗​(zt,t;c)=𝔼​[ut∣zt,t,c],v^{*}(z_{t},t;c)=\mathbb{E}[u_{t}\mid z_{t},t,c],

where cc denotes the conditioning information. For the first generation block, the ideal condition is

c=(zpre,zK),c=(z_{\mathrm{pre}},z_{K}),

namely, the clean prefix latent together with the clean known region inside the first block. Under clean condition repaint, the model effectively solves the transport problem under exactly this condition. In the unknown region, this can be viewed as a conditional velocity regression of the form

vclean∗​(zU,t,t;zpre,zK)=𝔼​[utU∣zU,t,t,zpre,zK].v^{*}_{\mathrm{clean}}(z_{U,t},t;z_{\mathrm{pre}},z_{K})=\mathbb{E}[u_{t}^{U}\mid z_{U,t},t,z_{\mathrm{pre}},z_{K}].

Although the implementation still predicts the vector field for the whole current block, the uncertainty that truly matters is concentrated on the unknown region, while the known region acts as a fixed boundary condition. This is precisely the role decomposition that the model is designed to exploit.

Why partial repaint is mathematically harder.

Partial repaint changes this problem in a crucial way. Instead of conditioning on the true clean known region zKz_{K}, it supplies a degraded and time-varying surrogate z~K,t\tilde{z}_{K,t} during only part of the trajectory. The effective condition becomes

c~t=(zpre,z~K,t),\tilde{c}_{t}=(z_{\mathrm{pre}},\tilde{z}_{K,t}),

and the corresponding optimal regression target becomes

vpartial∗​(zU,t,t;zpre,z~K,t)=𝔼​[utU∣zU,t,t,zpre,z~K,t].v^{*}_{\mathrm{partial}}(z_{U,t},t;z_{\mathrm{pre}},\tilde{z}_{K,t})=\mathbb{E}[u_{t}^{U}\mid z_{U,t},t,z_{\mathrm{pre}},\tilde{z}_{K,t}].

This is generally a more difficult regression problem. Since z~K,t\tilde{z}_{K,t} is only a noisy surrogate of the true condition, the same (zU,t,t,z~K,t)(z_{U,t},t,\tilde{z}_{K,t}) may correspond to a broader set of compatible clean targets. As a result, the conditional variance of the target velocity is larger. In terms of Bayes risk, one can compare

ℛ​(c)=𝔼​[Var​(utU∣zU,t,t,c)],ℛ​(c~t)=𝔼​[Var​(utU∣zU,t,t,c~t)].\mathcal{R}(c)=\mathbb{E}\!\left[\mathrm{Var}(u_{t}^{U}\mid z_{U,t},t,c)\right],\qquad\mathcal{R}(\tilde{c}_{t})=\mathbb{E}\!\left[\mathrm{Var}(u_{t}^{U}\mid z_{U,t},t,\tilde{c}_{t})\right].

Since c~t\tilde{c}_{t} is a weaker and noisier version of cc, the second quantity is generally larger. Therefore, partial repaint increases the irreducible uncertainty of the conditional velocity regression itself. From the Flow Matching perspective, its weakness is not simply that the guidance is softer, but that it turns a clean conditional transport problem into a noisier mixed recovery problem.

Condition-role mismatch in partial repaint.

There is also a structural mismatch. In 𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola DLM, the flow path is used for prior transport, not for observation recovery. Historical conditions are supposed to be stable anchors, while the current noisy block is the object being transported. Partial repaint violates this separation by converting the known region from a condition into a partially denoised state variable. In other words, it changes the task from

transport the unknown part under fixed condition

to

jointly maintain a noisy known part and transport the unknown part.\text{jointly maintain a noisy known part and transport the unknown part}.

This role confusion is especially harmful in the first generation block, because the known and unknown regions are tightly coupled inside the same block. Once the known side drifts, the unknown side no longer grows from a stable semantic anchor.

Why errors accumulate along the flow trajectory.

The weakness of partial repaint is further amplified by the continuous nature of flow-based generation. Let the ideal vector field under clean conditioning be v∗​(z,t;c)v^{*}(z,t;c), and let the field induced by partial repaint be

v~​(z,t)=v∗​(z,t;c)+δ​(z,t),\tilde{v}(z,t)=v^{*}(z,t;c)+\delta(z,t),

where δ\delta denotes the condition-induced bias. Since inference transports the latent by integrating the learned vector field along an ODE trajectory, this bias accumulates over time. Under standard stability assumptions, the trajectory error satisfies a bound of the form

‖z^t−zt∗‖≤eL​t​∫0t‖δ​(zs,s)‖​𝑑s,\|\hat{z}_{t}-z_{t}^{*}\|\leq e^{Lt}\int_{0}^{t}\|\delta(z_{s},s)\|\,ds,

where LL is a Lipschitz constant of the vector field. This expression makes the weakness of partial repaint especially clear.

First, reducing mm makes performance worse because the explicit guidance only covers an earlier portion of the trajectory. Once guidance is removed, the later part evolves under a mismatched condition, so the induced bias continues to accumulate during the unguided interval. Second, increasing tt from 11 to 33 does not provide stable gains because repeated corrections in the early stage cannot eliminate the structural mismatch in the later stage. In other words, repaint can repeatedly repair local early transitions, but it cannot turn a transient condition into a persistent one.

Why the first block is more sensitive than later blocks.

Another reason for the strong gap is that the first generation block is not a purely unknown block. The known and unknown regions coexist and interact inside the same block. Therefore, any instability in the known region is immediately transmitted to the unknown region through the within-block interactions. In latent space, this effect is even stronger because the known region functions as a semantic anchor rather than a mere token-level hint. If that anchor is kept clean, the model only needs to fit the unknown part to a stable context. If that anchor becomes noisy and drifts over time, the model must simultaneously infer the boundary condition and generate the completion, which is a fundamentally harder problem.

Why padding is better than partial repaint but still worse than clean conditioning.

Left and right padding do not explicitly re-noise the known region, so they avoid the most harmful failure mode of partial repaint. This is why they are often stronger than most partial repaint settings. However, padding alone still does not provide a fully stable conditioning mechanism throughout denoising. It changes the positional layout, but it does not lock the known region as an exact condition in the same way as clean condition repaint. Moreover, padding can also make the block-causal attention pattern more complicated: by reshaping the relative arrangement between the known and unknown regions, it may introduce a less natural or less aligned dependency structure for the model to follow during denoising. Therefore, padding can be helpful, but it cannot match the benefit of preserving a stable condition explicitly.

A unified intuition across all methods.

All methods in Table 5 are trying to solve the same problem: the first generation block contains both a part that should remain faithful to the prompt and a part that should be newly generated. The difference lies in how strongly the known region is protected.

Partial repaint protects it only temporarily and only approximately. Clean condition repaint protects it strongly and continuously. Left and right padding do not explicitly protect it during denoising, but instead hope that a favorable layout will make the interaction easier for the model.

How to read Table 5.

The results show a very clear pattern. Clean condition repaint consistently performs best across all three tasks. This suggests that, for the mixed denoising problem in the first block, strong and persistent conditioning is much more effective than soft partial correction. By contrast, reducing mm in partial repaint generally hurts performance, which indicates that shortening the guided portion of the trajectory makes the known region harder to preserve. Increasing the repaint cycles from t=1t=1 to t=3t=3 does not produce stable gains either, suggesting that repeatedly revisiting early denoising steps cannot by itself compensate for weak conditioning.

Another useful observation is that left and right padding are often stronger than partial repaint, but still remain clearly below clean condition repaint. This indicates that positional arrangement does matter, but it is not the main factor. In particular, although padding may alleviate some interference by changing the layout, it can also make the block-causal attention structure less clean and more difficult to optimize. The dominant advantage still comes from explicitly maintaining a stable condition in the known region throughout denoising.

Practical takeaway.

The first generation block is not merely a smaller version of later generation blocks. It is a special mixed region where conditioning and generation must coexist. From the perspective of conditional Flow Matching, the key challenge is to preserve the known region as a stable condition while transporting only the unknown region. The experiments suggest that this regime benefits most from a strong and explicit preservation of the known condition. In practice, this is exactly what clean condition repaint provides, which explains why it is consistently the strongest strategy in Table 5.

17.2 More Unified Approach Results with Image Modalities

In this section, we present additional samples that demonstrate cross-modal generation across different input and output modalities. It is worth emphasizing that all text and image outputs are produced by a single unified model. All tasks are pretrained from scratch, and the model is trained jointly on multiple task types, with the relative data proportions adjusted across different training stages. Although the model is trained with only a very limited amount of data, the resulting samples already exhibit promising quality, suggesting that 𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola DLM has substantial potential for multimodal understanding and generation.

17.2.1 Text to Text

In this subsection, we present examples of text-to-text generation. As shown in the samples, the generated text is generally coherent and fluent, despite the fact that the model is trained on only approximately 1B text tokens in total.

17.2.2 Text to Image

In this subsection, we further evaluate the model’s ability to perform text-to-image generation.

17.2.3 Image ×\times Text to Text

In this subsection, we present examples of image-and-text-to-text generation. The outputs are generally fluent and semantically aligned with the inputs. Notably, on top of a model that has received only limited text-generation and image-generation training, we further train with merely approximately 5M image–text pairs, after which the model already exhibits a preliminary captioning ability. This suggests that 𝒞​o​l​a\mathcal{C}ola DLM can efficiently acquire cross-modal understanding and generation capabilities under limited multimodal supervision. We also note that all images shown in this subsection are generated by external image generation models from ground-truth captions, and therefore do not involve copyright concerns associated with real images.
